1.2★ Lore: One of the 3 Blade Masters who fought in the Ancient War. Trained in the sword from a young age, and was as strong as a knight by 16. Only nobles could become knights in his birthplace of Isliid, however, and so he set off on a journey to perfect himself as a swordsman. Though he emerged victorious from countless battles, his teacher would later say his greatest talent was his penchant for meeting powerful foes.
1.3★ Lore: An Isliidian swordsman, and one of the 3 Blade Masters who fought in the Ancient War. After setting out on a journey to become the greatest swordsman, he fought countless battles against those who would later become heroes in the war. His fight against Mashreed, emperor of Isliid, is particularly notable. It is said the future emperor was so impressed by the swordsman's proud stature that he invited him to join the knights.
1.4★ Lore: An Isliidian swordsman later counted among the 3 Blade Masters. During his journey of self-improvement, a Great War between the Gods and Demons began. Clyde sought to fight as a mercenary, but a request from Isliid's emperor sent him to the capital. There the new emperor Mashreed, who Clyde had once battled against, chose Clyde to serve as leader of the imperial knights.
1.5★ Lore: One of the 3 Blade Masters who fought in the Ancient War. After becoming head of Isliid's knights, he deferred command, assembled a group of young knights and headed to the battlefield. With his trusted Flameblade Gladion in hand, he quickly laid waste to the Giant and Demon hordes opposing him. Those who were initially critical of him later came to revere him - a point of pride.
1.Awk★ Lore: Although being one of the 3 Blade Masters, he suddenly disappeared from history. It is not clear of this life after the Ancient War. There are several rumors about him such as, helping others during the harsh times after war, death and life battle with his master, or being killed by the emperor of Isliid due to his riot against him. However, one thing is in common, he had enormous power even after the war and bright fire in his eyes.

2.2★ Lore: One of the 3 Blade Masters who fought in the Ancient War. A highborn member of Bamint nobility, she received special education from birth. Though she excelled in every field, what she preferred most was sword training, and at the age of 16 was regarded as having skills equal to that of one of the country's knights
2.3★ Lore: A Bamint noble later counted among the 3 Blade Masters. On her 18th birthday, she discarded her favorite sword, a moment of joy for her father, who hoped she would settle down. She rebelled instead, leaving on a journey in pursuit of freedom. Using her sword skills to help those in need, this passionate swordswoman's ice magic-ensconced blade shines cold and beautiful.
2.4★ Lore: A Bamint swordswoman later counted among the 3 Blade Masters. Countless foes marked her days of travel, all sent by her father in an attempt to bring her home. Ironically, her victorious battles against them only honed her skills with the blade further. One day, an unusually vicious foe appeared before her. After defeating it, she vowed to return home, praying for her father's safety all the while.
2.5★ Lore: After returning to Bamint, Corsair found her father chatting happily with the assassin she thought she had defeated. Furious, her father smiled and informed her that, by defeating the strongest fighter in the land, she had earned herself a spot as a member of the knights. She would go on to fight in the Great War, becoming known as one of the 3 Blade Masters, but the look on her face was always a sour one.
2.Awk★ Lore: Although being one of the 3 Blade Masters, it is said that she created the reason for the royal family to fall. After the Ancient War, she was ordered to guard the prince of Bamint who was going to attend the 5 Kings Conference and even proposed. However, she declined this offer, and left the country. Her father did not criticize her for this. She is said to have fought with the other Blade Masters or have lived to bring up her adopted child. Her sword skills were the best during her last years.

3.2★ Lore: One of the 3 Blade Masters who fought in the Ancient War. Son of one of Gramenia's great swordmasters, Arth was renowned as a genius swordsman from youth. To improve his abilities even further, he began developing techniques that broke from tradition. It's said that his teacher - who was also his father - observed his training quietly at first, only to reprimand him severely when he took up two swords.
3.3★ Lore: A Gramenian swordsman later counted among the 3 Blade Masters. After taking up a twin- bladed style not seen in any school, Arth dueled his father and won. While this lead to his expulsion, his father advised that he open a new school of his own to impart his style to a new generation. Arth rejected this and continued improving his skills, speaking to others only about swords.
3.4★ Lore: A Gramenian swordsman later counted among the 3 Blade Masters. The story goes that when he heard of the massive war between Gods and Demons during his sword training, he immediately headed to the battlefield. Aligned with the Gods, Arth achieved many great military victories, he once turned and bore witness to the unspeakable devastation that had been wrought. Shocked senseless, his blades dropped to the ground.
3.5★ Lore: In the midst of the Great War between Gods and Demons, Arth dropped his blades and returned to his wartorn hometown, but took them up again upon seeing the devastation. This time, his blades would be used not to destroy, but to rebuild, with a pair of blades from his father. Armed with these new earth magic-infused swords, Arth fought to help others, coming to be known as the holy sword.
3.Awk★ Lore: After he became a teacher of sword skills for Gramenia Republic, other than leaving the country once, he remained, and people greatly thanked him for his selfless devotion. On the other hand, he sometimes had a look of sorrow on his face. He hated to meet high officials on an extreme degree. He stayed single for his whole life. On his 80th birthday, surrounded by his disciples, he passed away with last words of "Was I forgiven?" His sword skills are still passed down to the next generation.

4.2★ Lore: A holy knight who rose to prominence in Famelle shortly before the start of the Ancient War. Her furious sword moves belied her appearance and she was regarded as the best in the kingdom. She was tasked with a certain duty because of her unerring faith toward the Gods, and departed on a journey to fulfill it. Feena and a knight of La Riiz would later be known as the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, but little is known about her.
4.3★ Lore: A member of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, duo famous after the Ancient War. Entrusted with a secret duty by the Kingdom of Famelle, she visited every land under Human rule, and saved members of other races from oppression in more than one occasion. To this day, many know her from bard songs, championing her as the Luminous Knight. There are also stories of her meeting with key figures from every country during her journey.
4.4★ Lore: A member of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, duo famous after the Ancient War. After visiting all the lands ruled by Humans, she headed to the lands ruled by Gods. When war between Gods and Demons broke out, she was allowed to join the Gods Army despite not being a God herself. It is said even Demons feared her on the battlefield. Toward the end of the war, she heard of a crisis befalling Famelle, and received permission to return home.
4.5★ Lore: After returning home, the war reached its end. With the Gods and Demons sealing themselves, and the other races on the verge of destruction, she chose to ignore boundaries of race to aid those in need. Her holy light inspired those in the throes of despair, and led them to call her Knight of the Morning Star. Despite the legends, her absence from Famellian historical records remains a mystery to this day.
4.Awk★ Lore: One of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, who, like the Holy Mother, brought healing and charity to the people. Tales of her generosity have been handed down through every land, and though there is no trace in the history books, they tell of how she brought soothing to those in need weeping as she did. The reason of her tears remains a mystery even now, but there are those who say she used to mutter words of apology, as well as the name of a vanished God.

5.2★ Lore: A knight of the Raven's Aegis, a troop of La Riiz dedicated to protecting sorcerers. While the troop emphasized defense, Regulus opted not to carry a shield, focusing on offense instead. Nonetheless, he remained in the troop, both because his sword skills saved more sorcerers than any shield, and because he lacked the capacity for magic himself. He would later achieve renown as one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star.
5.3★ Lore: A member of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, duo famous after the Ancient War. Just before the start of the Ancient War, when tensions between Gods and Demons were at their peak, Regulus spent time away from his fellow knights. Records of his battles with knights across the land suggest this was a training pilgrimage, but it's also rumored that he received a secret mission from La Riiz' High Council to visit Human-controlled lands.
5.4★ Lore: A member of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, duo famous after the Ancient War. Regulus challenged not just Humans during his travels, but countless other races as well. One of his famous achievement was the battle against the Flamewyrm Dargeon, which lasted three days and three nights before the final draw, that made his name renowned even among Dragons. This only incremented his opponents, who, regardless of race, challenged him, increasing his skills to the apex.
5.5★ Lore: When the Ancient War broke out, Regulus returned to La Riiz to rejoin his troop. A veteran of battles against all the races, Regulus inspired bravery in his companions and countrymen. After Gods and Demons vanished from the world at the end of the war, he traveled with a lady knight to help those in need: a duo that came to be known as the Twin Knights of the Morning Star. Strangely, no record of his deeds after this point remains...
5.Awk★ Lore: After the end of the Ancient War, he was known as one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, but before that, he was already famous for saving the Magus Empire of La Riiz from great peril. He stood against the God Eater Mavroskia, which brings calamity wherever it appears, and turned its rampage. This is the only time in history a God Eater's destruction has been limited so far. They say he had the protection of a certain Witch, but his merit in the story is undeniable.

6.Name: Rekyuon
6.1★ Lore: A magical creature with the power of fire found all over Raktehelm. In contrast to its adorable appearance and speech, it is highly aggressive. Unassuming travelers will try to pet it only to receive a fierce bite. There many reports of such victims, but since these monsters are barely strong enough to break skin, they are not regarded as a true threat.
6.2★ Lore: When the flame spirit attached to a Rekyuon becomes enlarged or enraged, this is the result. Its speech becomes rougher to match its change in appearance. Rekyuons are both stronger and smaller in number, and you can occasionally see King Rekyuons frustrated that its smaller bretheren won't fall in line. Their aggressive natures remain unchanged, however.

7.Name: Mikyuon
7.1★ Lore: Magical, water-infused creatures found in every region of Raktehelm. Researchers have determined that their bodies is composed almost entirely of water, and congregate in watery areas. They possess gentle demeanors and rarely attack Humans, but watch out: Mikyuons wandering by the road can be difficult to distinguish from puddles. Novice adventurers should take caution to avoid slipping.
7.2★ Lore: A large number of Mikyuons often swarmwet areas following long rains, absorbing a huge amount of water and becoming this, the mighty King Mikyuon, in the process. Though larger and more powerful, it remains a quiet, subdued creature, and not particularly threatening. The sight of these creatures lounging at the end of the rainy season is often dubbed a Mikyuon Meeting.

8.Name: Mokyuon
8.1★ Lore:
Magical creatures infused with the power of trees. Live in beautiful forests away from natural predators. Natural cowards, Mokyuon hide in the shadow of the leaves as soon as they sense Humans, making them virtually invisible to novice adventurers. Guilds tend to treat an adventurer's first Mokyuon sighting as a treasured right of passage for this
very reason.
8.2★ Lore:
Mokyuon gets big, and with that size comes newfound confidence...or maybe just the ability to hide how scared it is. Its defining physical characteristic is the massive flower
sprouting from its forehead, which continues to grow along with the Mokyuon. As such, it's possible to determine how old the Mokyuon is based on the flower's size and number of petals. According to researchers, anyway.

9.Name: Pikyuon
9.1★ Lore: It's relatively easy to determine where most creatures of the -cuon genus can be found. Not so with Pikyuons, which can appear very nearly anywhere. Ancient ruins and stormswept wetlands are both Pikyuon hotspots, a cause of headaches for many biologists. There's likely no deep reason for this
9.2★ Lore:
Pikyuons act as they please, appearing in all sorts of locations. Once they grow, however, they stop moving as much. The dominant theory is that Pikyuons only grow after finding
a companion, which they then settle down to have a family with. The results of further research to explain why young Pikyuons can be found in dangerous ancient ruins is forthcoming.

10.Name: Dakyuon
10.1★ Lore: Magical creatures suffused with the power of darkness, Dakyuons can typically be found in caves, and come equipped with massive horns and bat-like wings. Quite spooky. They're also proud, greeting trespassing adventurers with a show of force. Their adorable outward appearance means adventurers frequently assume they're trying to play, giving many Dakyuons a profound inferiority complex.
10.2★ Lore: Big Dakyuons are just as proud as their petite compatriots, attacking trespassers on sight. Their increased size means increased damage, so adventurers are advised to take caution. Countless tales exist of King Dakyuons leading moribund adventurers to cave exits, however, leading some to believe that King Dakyuons don't just have bigger bodies, but bigger hearts, as well.

11.Name: Magibeast Gaul
11.1★ Lore: Beasts that dwell within Raktehelm's volcanic regions. With their powerful legs and sharp fangs, you're unlikely to come out of a fight with one unscathed. They're also extremely territorial and will attack perceived trespassers on sight, requiring guilds across the land to mark Gaul habitats on any maps they release. The best defense against a Gaul's territorial instincts is to not trigger it, after all.
11.2★ Lore: It is said that Gauls, driven to the brink of starvation, may consume a flame spirit and evolve into this terrifying form. Augmented with the power of flame, a Gillius is far more dangerous than a Gaul, and novice adventurers who encounter one and survive to tell the tale are rare. Some strange folk find their appearance appealing, and stuffed ones are rumored to sell for a considerable sum on the black market.

12.Name: Priest Leader
12.Skill Detail: 800% Water DMG (Magic). Heals all Allies' HP by 30.
12.1★ Lore:
A priest who fought for Bamint during the Ancient war. Dedicated to the protection of others, her services were appreciated by many of
the races. If she happened upon a wounded creature, she would use her powers to help without hesitation. However, one high-ranking officer saw her actions as traitorous. The soldiers ordered to arrest her faced opposition from enemy and ally alike.
12.2★ Lore: A Bamint priest who provided aid to those in need, regardless of affiliation. Branded a traitor and chased out of her unit, she was guided to sanctuary by those she had helped. The order to arrest her was later rescinded, and she returned to providing aid as she had before. Knowing that everything she had done was not in vain led to her improving her abilities and saving countless more lives.

13.Name: Megarock Dohmal
13.Arts Detail: Reduces enemies' DMG to all Allies by 10% for some time.
13.1★ Lore: Statues created in temples by peace-seeking artisans. After watching over the populace for lengths untold, the prayer for peace was broken. All-out war between Gods and Demons had erupted. Countless people sought refuge in the temple, but the Demons found them. Just as hope seemed lost, a miracle occurred: an unspeaking statue rose, using its massive stony frame to stop the Demons in their tracks.
13.2★ Lore: A statue that fought to protect innocent lives. Answering the prayers of the people, the statue continued to fight against the Demons' overwhelming hordes, witnessing a mother slain in an attempt to protect her daughter. As the daughter's cries rang out, the battered stone statue felt tremendous power welling up inside it. It unleashed its remaining power in a demon-obliterating cascade of light.

14.Name: Fairy Claris
14.Skill Detail: 800% Earth DMG (Magic). Heals all Allies' HP by 30.
14.1★ Lore: A variety of fairy inhabiting forest depths, she enjoys mischief, but is quite shy around Humans, preferring to follow lost visitors to the forest from the shadows. When an opening presents itself for innocent mischief, she takes it, letting her victim go once satisfied, and ultimately leading them back to the forest entrance. If you ever hear cute voices in the forest, it's probably Claris and her friends you're hearing.
14.2★ Lore: A variety of spirit that calls the forest depths home. One explanation is that she's the result of helpful fairy Claris merging with a spirit. She has a slightly more relaxed air to her, but shows her original naughty side from time to time. Like Claris, she provides help to lost forest visitors, but she uses the light of her radiant wings to do so, instead of her words. In the end, she still enjoys playing tricks on people.

15.Name: Granbat
15.Arts Detail: 6200% Dark DMG (Physical). Chance of Seals Enemy.
15.1★ Lore: Large bats that make their homes in cave depths. Their bloodsucking nature makes them hated by most races. Weak to sunlight, they spend the day in the darkness of caves, leaving at night to hunt for prey. Cattle farmers frequently inscribe their homes with holy seals to prevent Granbats from feeding on their livestock
15.2★ Lore: Granbats that survive eventually grow large from years of bloodsucking antics. They don't just suck the blood of other creatures, but their very life force itself. Swarms of Granbats follow their leader, turning nearby habitats into lifeless wastelands. For this reason, some regions of Isliid believe that on the full moon, with skies full of bats, the Grim Reaper itself flies to reap the souls of the living.

16.Name: Gobl
16.1★ Lore: A subclass of the Demons living in Raktehelm, these diminutive tricksters make up for their lack of strength with alertness and the smarts necessary to use weapons. They also breed quickly, giving them massive numbers that can be trained into an armed force if necessary. They'll quickly turn on their master if they don't receive satisfactory compensation, however, making army maintenance a struggle.
16.2★ Lore: Small demons that dwell in Raktehelm. The Greater Gobling is the most combat-ready member of the Gobling family, and there are relatively few of them in comparison. They're far stronger than their diminutive brethren, and pose a significant threat to anyone they perceive as an enemy. They also have a unique desire to rise in the ranks, and are known to sell their services as mercenaries.

17.Name: Sardine
17.1★ Lore: Found in Raktehelm's coastal waters, these fish have respected the law since ancient times, and possess a large and strictly regulated navy. It's said that a massive whirlpool formed in the part of the sea where they originally took military action. They're also quite proud of living in the sea, and refer to the other races as "land dwellers" - though they tend to look past that if you're strong and noble.
17.2★ Lore: Sardions are what result when a Sardine puts in significant training. Fast underwater and competent short term surface fighters, one fights with a Sardion at their peril. Their spear technique emphasizes "the first thrust," and focuses on winning battles with one thrust. Sardions put a staggering amount of spirit into their devastating spear thrusts, which can fell even Sea Dragons, the kings of the sea.

18.Name: Coroc
18.V.A:
Kumiko Ito
Yoshie Saitou
Kenji Takahashi
18.1★ Lore: Spirits born from millennia-old trees that serve as the workers of the forest. They tirelessly work in groups ot maintain the forests they were born in. Because of their innocent, hardworking personalities, they'll fight for you with all their might should you befriend them. Don't let their cut appearances deceive you. Get on their bad sides, and you're going to regret it.
18.2★ Lore: A worker of the forest after years of growth. With a larger body and increased physical strength Corograns don't just maintain the forests they protect them. The owner of a large plantation once attempted to use Corograns for maintenance, but because he had built his plantation over a forest, he was judged guilty of crimes against nature, and their wrath claimed his plantation in moments.

19.Name: Unicorn
19.Arts Detail: Heals all allies' HP by 500. Chance of Blinds Enemy.
19.1★ Lore: One-horned Beasts so rare that many doubt their existence. Scornful of impurity, they're said to only appear before the pure of heart. The horn on its forehead is its defining feature, and those who earn a Unicorn's scorn quickly find themselves on the receiving end. Unicorns are frequently targeted by greedy merchants and poachers due to the restorative properties of their horns, but few have succeeded.
19.2★ Lore: Legendary holy beasts said to have served as war horses in the armies of the gods. Their horns are said to judge the guilty. Long ago, a Demon chased by a Monoceros took a young girl hostage in an attempt to escape. With a furious neigh, the holy beast pierced both of them without hesitation. The Demon breathed its last with a shock of surprise still on its face, the young girl miraculously unscathed.

20.Name: Skeleton
20.1★ Lore: The spirits of fallen soldiers mingle with umbral elements to create these undead warriors. With none of their living memories intact, they follow a hunger for battle and thirst for life into combat. Stories abound of victorious armies facing devastation at the hands of their now-skeletal foes, and modern militaries always bring a priest along to purify the souls of their fallen enemies.
20.2★ Lore: Long ago, to combat a chronic shortage of soldiers, a La Riizian dark wizard proposed imbuing the dead with transient souls, creating these shambling undead warriors, and solving the military labor shortage in the process. While the Spartoi won many victories, no record of their existence can be found in La Riiz's history books, and are only briefly mentioned in the dark wizard's notebooks.

21.Arts Detail: 7200% Fire DMG (Magic). Chance of Burns Enemy.

2★.Arts Detail: 7200% Fire DMG (Magic). Chance of Burns Enemy.

21.2★ Lore: Young firewyrms that live in volcanic areas. According to researchers, these creatures have special organs that allow them to store flame. Dubbed "Agni's heart," these organs allow dragons to convert the heat energy from food into flames, which can be used to generate their signature flame breath. For this reason, adventurers will fare best against firewyrms forced to fight on an empty stomach.
21.3★ Lore: Firewyrms that have lived for long periods of time are referred to as Grovoggs. In times past, there was a kingdom that prospered off of volcanic mining. They built a mighty stone city in the domain of a firewyrm, drawing its wrath. The city was destroyed in a torrent of flame, but in an ironic twist of fate, the city's stone structures survived and remain to this day, serving as valuable reference for researchers.

22.Name: Siren
22.2★ Lore: Sirens are half-Human, half-fish, and live in the ocean, causing them to sometimes be confused for fish people, but their personalities are very different. While most fish people are gentle, Sirens enjoy attacking Humans. They appear from the seas and lure ships into the depths, stealing the souls of all on board. No matter the era, few can resist the Siren's song, even at the cost of their life.
22.3★ Lore: A demon whose top half is that of a beautiful woman, situated on top of a fish/beast/snake body. Much like sirens, the Scylla attacks Humans, but seeks their flesh in addition to their souls. They also have powerful magic in addition to their voluptuous charms, leading seafarers of all genders to their dooms. Rumors suggest that she was born from the curse of a queen who was sacrificed at sea.

23.Name: Troll
23.2★ Lore: Boasting massive frames and clubs roughly the size of your average Human, Trolls attack anything that steps in front of them, making them very dangerous indeed for anyone who encounters one. They also enjoy collecting shiny objects, and Troll domiciles are often filled with the stolen weapons and treasures of fallen adventurers...at least, based on reports from the few who survived such encounters.
23.3★ Lore: These one-eyed Giants dwell in forest depths, are considerably larger than Humans and have monstrous strength to boot. Once retainers of the Gods, they fomented insurrection and were expelled. Though extremely violent, they coexist relatively well with the other inhabitants of the forest. In Gonal forest, one can occasionally find a Cyclops taking a leisurely walk with a Corok or two riding on its shoulder.

24.Name: Vaala
24.2★ Lore: Shining birds that live in western Famelle's mountainous regions. "Vaala" means "light" in ancient Famellian. Glimpsing one is believed to bring good fortune, leading many to the ancient ruins where they roost. The increase in visitors has made maintaining the ruins difficult, however, leading their roosts to come under royal management, with access strictly limited to ensure their preservation.
24.3★ Lore: After a long period of time, Vaalas evolve into this form. Known as "radiant birds," only one Vaala in a flock is chosen by the sun god to become a Mel-Vaala, with only a single chosen bird said to exist in a given generation. Countless legends exist throughout Raktehelm of heroes visited by the radiant bird going on to lead the world through times of crisis - an all too fitting role for emissaries of the sun god.

25.Name: Model SX-602
25.Arts Detail: 6100% Dark DMG (Physical). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

2★.Arts Detail: 6100% Dark DMG (Physical). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

25.2★ Lore: Mechanical weapons that appeared during the Great War. Since its material construction and the letters inscribed on it are not of Raktehelm, it was thought to have been a visitor from another world charged with some kind of mission. Not long after arriving in this world, it began attacking the Gods and Demons indiscriminately, but the Demons repurposed them to attack and exterminate their enemies.
25.3★ Lore: An otherworldly mechanical weapon strengthened by the Demons' necromancy into a terrifyingly powerful, nigh-invulnerable killing machine. Its firepower was said to be equivalent to an entire company. While it delivered tremendous results in the countless battles it was deployed in, the murderous machine was finally destroyed - albeit at great cost - via the combined efforts of multiple races during Operation Rignald Dawn.

26.Name: Beast Fighter Wald
26.Arts Detail: 7300% Fire DMG (Magic). Increases all allies' ATK by 15% for 15s.

2★.Arts Detail: 7300% Fire DMG (Magic). Increases own ATK by 15% for 15s.

26.2★ Lore: A Beast warrior who fought during the Great War. Wald was once a mere soldier, but was selected to lead a squadron as the King of Beasts after a fearless battle against the dragons. Wielding a flamewreathed spear, he is said to have cut a path forward alone. His men took pride in him, and were inspired by his strength to continue their own furious onslaught. That is, until the day they fell prey to an enemy trap...
26.3★ Lore: The King of Beasts, who fought during the great war. After losing half his squad to an enemy trap, he trained himself not just to avoid future ones, but to overcome them entirely. His improved spear skills pierced trap and foe alike, sending enemy schemers to their doom. Even Wald's foes thought of him as fearless, and while that confidence may have led to a downfall of sorts, he recovered even stronger than before.

27.Name: Warrior Darun
27.2★ Lore: A Bamint mercenary who crushed countless foes with his massive axe, Darun's name soon rose to prominence among Bamint's knights. Even more famous, however, was his tendency to chew out and threaten his commanding officer with his axe if he didn't like him. Though considered for the knights, his bad behavior and perceived lack of interest led to the proposal being deferred indefinitely.
27.3★ Lore: A Bamint mercenary, Darun's renown only grew further after Bamint's battle against the Demons. Ensared by an enemy feint, his mercenary squadron found itself surrounded by enemy soldiers. While his fellow mercs considered escape or desertion, Darun charged in alone, sending the enemy into disarray and buying his squad an opening to escape. "It had the best odds," he said afterwards.

28.Name: Crowe, the Bandit
28.2★ Lore: A thief who worked primarily in Gramenia. Prior to the Great War, Crowe targeted wealthy Gramenians, and had massive bounties placed on his head. His movements were said to be as swift and graceful as the winds, and he often baffled the guards sent to capture him. When he wasn't stealing from the rich to aid the poor, he just stole - made considerably more difficult when passersby would cheer him on.
28.3★ Lore: This Gramenian thief changed his behavior after the war started, targeting enemy communiques and gossip instead of precious jewels. Crowe would use the jewels to amass large crowds, who he would then announced his newly pilfered information to. Though unclear in motive, a certain girl would later say that he was trying to end the war by communicating its utter meaninglessness.

29.Name: Skyknight Elsa
29.2★ Lore: A knight of the Gods who participated in the Great War. Said to appear with a thunderclap and vanish like lightning, Elsa's blade was so fast that foes who heard her speak knew it was already too late. She never fought of her own volition, always working under divine orders to provide divine protection. For this reason, those who bore witness to her inevitably found themselves recalling their past deeds...
29.3★ Lore: A knight of the Gods who participated in the Great War, her first target in the battle against the Demons is said to have been people, leading her to be opposed to the war. Historians believe she wished to carry out her original role of passing judgement on the sinful, but she later fought against the Demons and other races, achieving countless battlefield successes. She never named herself when she did so, however.

30.Name: Forner
30.2★ Lore: A grave defiler said to have roamed graveyards at night during the Great War, gathering corpses of the powerful. These corpses are said to have been used as research material for the Demons, but the exact purpose and nature of the research is unclear. Those who witnessed Forner firsthand were turned into corpses themselves, and children were warned not to talk to any elderly people they met in cemeteries.
30.3★ Lore: Forner, who defiled graves during the great war, is well known. Schroder, who appeared toward the war's end, is more obscure, and pursued corpse collection with even greater vigilance... which explains why so few people witnessed his actions and lived to tell about it. Those who attempted to escape heard a cackling voice urging them to become feed for new life... just as their own ended.

31.Name: Fraid
31.2★ Lore: A magical creature that dwells within caves. Defining characteristics include a single, large eye and rocky body, within which burns a flame requiring it to subsist on a mostly fire-based diet. A flame mage once used its magic in a cave, and a horde of Fraids soon gathered, eyes fixated on the mage's torch. Why would a magical flame draw their attention so thoroughly? Maybe they were just hungry.
31.3★ Lore: A Fraid that starts eating and doesn't stop eventually ingests too much flame for its body to handle. It collapses, stops moving, and explodes violently. There are even islands that have been obliterated completely in the wake of a Big Fraid's blowup. For this reason, it's imperative to fearlessly flee immediately after defeating a Big Fraid.

32.Name: Diever
32.Arts Detail: 7200% Water DMG (Magic). Increases Water Elemental Unit's ATK by 15% for 15s.

2★.Arts Detail: 7200% Water DMG (Magic). Increases Water Elemental Unit's ATK by 15% for 15s.

32.2★ Lore: A type of spirit that lives in Raktehelm, Dievers have massive, well-developed jaws with sharp fangs. Once they bite down, they're not coming off. They have countless sensory organs known as "Abyssal Eyes" that emit ultrasonic waves to track prey. Many assume them to be aquatic creatures based on appearance. Since they're spirits, they can also operate on land without consequence.
32.3★ Lore: A Diever absorbs powerful aquatic elements, transforming into a mighty Diemrova. Its "Abyssal Eyes" enlarge, allowing it to detect prey fine differences in heat and even magic. There are stories of fish people who rode Diemrovas into battle as "Deep Riders" in the Great War of long ago, but it appears that the techniques for riding such creatures no longer exist in the present day.

33.Name: Ragveloth
33.Arts: Claws and Fangs Flash Gust Blade
33.2★ Lore: The twin blades on this beast's arms led to it being colloquially referred to as a bladewolf. Its signature blades were once wings, allowing a Ragveloth to fly for short bursts. Once they started being bred as hunting beasts, however, flight was deemed unnecessary, and the wings modified into sharp blades, which can cut through commonly used Milam steel shields like a cold knife through warm butter.
33.3★ Lore: On a full moon, a Ragveloth unleashes its true power. The blades on its arms get bigger and sharper, developing beautiful, wave-like patterns. Its hunting instincts are at their sharpest now, and - since they're clearly weaker - a Ragvelon doesn't so much as look at normal folk. The only opponent this hunter of the forest is willing to turn its blades upon is one with power equal to or greater than its own.

34.Name: Oglo
34.2★ Lore: An extremely rare breed of Beast thought extinct until the time of the Great War. His fur stores minute electrical charges from the air, continuously enveloping his body in electricity. Hidden deep within the mountains alongside his few allies, a sudden Demon attack led to the loss of his allies and imprisonment as a test subject. What he saw before the cage snapped shut were other rare finds like himself.
34.3★ Lore: A rare Beast imprisoned by Demons. During an attempt to escape from the research facility, he and his friends were sighted by guards. Forced to fight at a disadvantage while protecting his weaker allies, a miracle occurred when all seemed lost: his powerful will to protect his friends unleashed a powerful hidden strength, obliterating their pursuers with lightning and allowing a safe escape from the facility.

35.Name: Wyvern
35.2★ Lore: A particularly rare breed of Dragon, the flames that envelop the Wyvern include dark elements, and are said not to burn the flesh, but the mind and spirit. Extremely intelligent, it once spoke the languages of all eight races, but had its ability to speak revoked as punishment for  stealing the dark arts of the Gods and bestowing them upon Humans. Its craftiness remains, however, and so it remains a formidable threat.
35.3★ Lore: A high-class dark dragon possessed of great intelligence and a fickle personality, the source of which is said to be impossible for Humans to understand. The dark dragons stole the secrets of the gods, with Fafnir achieving full comprehension of the dark arts. Legend speaks of a magician drinking Fafnir's blood in search of similar comprehension, and learning a hundred tongues and a thousand spells as a result.

36.Name: Flamefist Diana
36.Passives 1 Detail: You can additionally tap to attack while Skill is activated.

2★.Passives 1 Detail: You can additionally tap to attack while Skill is activated.

3★.Skill Detail: 1400% Fire DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6300% Fire DMG (Physical).
3★.Passives 1 Detail: You can additionally tap to attack while Skill is activated.

36.2★ Lore: A highborn female fighter from Isliid, Diana trained in self-defense from an early age, and by her 16th birthday was the strongest in her dojo. One day, however, she suffered utter defeat at the hands of a wandering swordsman, who told her he was not the kind of man to hold back, even against the highborn daughters of famous houses. Filled with shame, regret, and rage, Diana vowed at that moment to leave home.
36.3★ Lore: A fighter from Isliid, Diana ignored the protests of those around her to journey in pursuit of two goals: abandoning her family name, and growing as a fighter. And if she found that swordsman she lost to, all the better. Her resolve erased the weakness she'd carried up to this point, and prepared her for the challenge of growing stronger. Fighting countless martial artists strengthened her both as a fighter and as a Human being.
36.4★ Lore: A fighter from Isliid. After war broke out between Gods and Demons, Diana was visited by an emissary requesting she return home. Though she initially agreed, upon hearing of their new knight captain, Diana changed course, enlisting as a mercenary and fighting in battlefields across the world, and only returning home upon hearing that the knights there were in danger, rescuing the knight commander with a smile.

37.Name: Gunman Void

3★.Skill Detail: 1500% Water DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 7000% Water DMG (Physical).

37.2★ Lore: A Bamint bounty hunter employing "guns," a weapon invented by Machines, to make a considerable name for himself. Though often thought of as impulsive due to his overconfident manner, a friend of his assures us that he's an expert at sizing up foes, choosing to run from unwinnable situations. Before meeting that friend, however, no one knew that side of him, striking fear into bounties far and wide.
37.3★ Lore: A bounty hunter who uses "guns," a Machine invention, to hunt his prey. Though known for his solitary personality, he ended up meeting a life-long friend in battle - a pirate with a bounty Void was looking to collect. Instantly realizing they were evenly matched, he strangely felt none of his usual trepidation. A monster interrupted their fight, forcing a draw, and uniting the two as friends from that day forward.
37.4★ Lore: Void continued his bounty hunting duties after befriending the pirate. One day, he discovered that military officials and politicians in his homeland of Bamint were working with the Demons. He investigated solo, but sent a letter to his pirate friend just in case. Ultimately the pirate clashed with Bamint's navy, but Void would be remembered for finding the truth and spurring one of the 3 Blade Masters to action.

38.Name: Heavy Armor Gradis

3★.Skill Detail: 1300% Earth DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6000% Earth DMG (Physical).

38.2★ Lore: A heavily armored soldier who fought for Gramenia during the Great War. Though he chose to pursue swordsmanship from a young age, the presence of a future Blade Master in his school pushed him to follow a different path. Realizing he could never become master of the blade, he chose to master the spear instead. Though many questioned his decision at first, he would become an indispensable member of the Gramenian forces.
38.3★ Lore: A heavily armored soldier who fought for Gramenia during the Great War. Though respected by many for his simple and sturdy character and reliability on the battlefield, few cadets were interested in following in his footsteps. That is, until one of the 3 Blade Masters described Gradis's strength as one of Gramenia's treasures. He would hide the complicated feelings this inspired as he strove to raise the next generation of armored defenders.
38.4★ Lore: A heavily armored soldier from Gramenia who led an armored battalion at the outset of the Great War. Though the country's swordsmen frequently found themselves in danger after rushing off alone, Gradis's squad proved their saviors time and again. Though his men felt pride in their accomplishments, he quietly admonished them to focus on accomplishing their roles while striving to grow and improve.

39.Name: Hunter Phalle

3★.Skill Detail: 1300% Light DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6150% Light DMG (Physical).

39.2★ Lore: An illusive hunter from Famelle who lived in the nearby forests of Gonal, few official records of his exploits exist. Abundant rumors speak of a hunter who hunted criminals instead of  innocent animals, and who may have even been a winged God instead of a Human. Phalle was oblivious to all of this, however, and continued protecting those who wandered into the forest from monster attacks and other calamities.
39.3★ Lore: An illusive hunter who grew famous after monsters appeared in Famelle. With the town guard absent and overworked, and monster attacks growing more frequent, the citizenry succumbed to terror. That's when Phalle appeared, striking down the monsters with arrows suffused in lightning. He was soon a household name, but the rumors persisted in asking the same question as before: just who was this guy?
39.4★ Lore: An illusive Famellian hunter who remained in his homeland even after the outbreak of war between Gods and Demons. Though his life continued mostly unchanged, he would strike like a bolt of lightning if he saw children or the elderly threatened by war. His reasons for remaining in Famelle are unclear, but the dominant theory is that he remained to perform some kind of role for friends: a female holy knight and God knight.

40.Name: Dark Mage Ognard

3★.Skill Detail: 1800% Dark DMG (Magic).
3★.Arts Detail: 7400% Dark DMG (Magic).

40.2★ Lore: An instructor at La Riiz's Arcanist Academy. Though a powerful Arcanist, Ognard disliked fighting, choosing to become a teacher instead. In contrast to his expertise in the dark arts, Ognard was a kind soul, and popular among his students. During a training exercise, he found himself in enemy territory on accident, and his entire class was wiped out. From that day on, he was transferred to a post in magical research.
40.3★ Lore: After being transferred to La Riiz's Dark Arts Lab, something seemed to shift in Ognard's personality. His gentle warmth vanished as he immersed himself in his research. However, nobody at the facility knew what he was studying, and abundant rumors suggested the High Council had tasked him with a confidential mission. One thing was certain: his magic was significantly stronger following the end of his research.
40.4★ Lore: A magician of La Riiz, Ognard left the lab following the outbreak of war between Gods and Demons, becoming advisor to a powerful councilman. Though he never commanded soldiers directly, his directives did influence military decision-making. Though his goals were unclear, his actions clearly targeted other races, and records indicate they viewed him as a considerable threat.

41.Name: Princess Faron
41.Arts Detail: 6000% Fire DMG (Physical). Increases all Allies' Break Power by 20% for 15s.

3★.Skill Detail: 1400% Fire DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6000% Fire DMG (Physical). Increases all Allies' Break Power by 20% for 15s.

41.3★ Lore: The princess of a lost land who fought alongside Giants in the Great War. Her father once ruled a  small country, but a Bamint invasion wiped it off the map. Her mother sacrificed herself to save her daughter but Faron found herself in lands ruled by Giants. Instead of harming her, however, they brought her under their care. From that day forward, it is said she trusted the word of Giants over that of Humans.
41.4★ Lore: The princess of a lost land who fought alongside Giants after the start of the Great War. Her intelligence made the Giants' considerable might even mightier, and drew out the latent potential of all Giants under her command. Though her Giants fought against many races during the war, it was only in battles against Humans that Faron's capacity for cruelty made itself known.

42.Name: Spirit Swordsman Noa

3★.Skill Detail: 1600% Water DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6400% Water DMG (Physical).

42.3★ Lore: There was once a swordsman who, though a God, chose to live as a Human. He trained in the sword as a God for years before concluding that true strength could only be found in the life of a mortal, concealing his Godhood to live in a Human settlement. He couldn't hide his noble character, however, taking many requests from the villagers, and seeing their smiles gave birth to new emotions within him.
42.4★ Lore: Once a God, this elderly swordsman chose to live as a Human. At the outbreak of the great war, an emissary from the Gods asked him to return and fight the Demon threat. Noa declined, choosing to remain in the village. Though Demons attacked his humble hamlet, he obliterated them in an instant. His Godhood revealed, the villagers smiled and welcomed him back with open arms.

43.Name: Beast Speaker Ren
43.Passives 1 Detail: Seal Time Reduction & Seal Evasion rate 30% UP.

3★.Skill Detail: 1500% Earth DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6150% Earth DMG (Physical).
3★.Passives 1 Detail: Seal Time Reduction & Seal Evasion rate 20% UP.

43.3★ Lore: Beast records tell of a strange girl who, despite being born among Humans, could converse with Beasts. She was viewed with suspicion by others and treated callously, until one day she left her hometown and headed to a Beast village. The head of the village saw this Human girl, with no possessions to her name beyond a fierce stare, and welcomed her as a friend, vowing to protect her from any harm that might come her way.
43.4★ Lore: Several theories exist as to why Ren could speak with Beasts. Perhaps she was an illegitimate child of the Beast village chief, or a distant Beast descendant. What stands out most is not her birthplace, but her battlefield achievements. Though she fought in the Great War as a Beast, countless comrades went to the battlefield of their own volition to protect her. Naturally, people came to call her... the Beast Princess.

44.Name: Terror Blade Rizer

3★.Skill Detail: 1500% Light DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6300% Light DMG (Physical).

44.3★ Lore: Shortly before the start of the war, there was a warrior known as the Terror Blade. Stories say he challenged well-known swordsmen and Demons to sharpen his abilities. A common story, certainly. What stands out is the reason for his name: those who lost to him would fear combat for the rest of their lives. His terrifying fighting style inspired the fear of death and certainty of defeat in his foes. Rizer would just say they sucked, however.
44.4★ Lore: After the start of the Great War, the Terror Blade was hired as a mercenary for the Gods, for the simple reason that the only defeat he suffered during his days as a wandering warrior came at the hands of a Demon named Orochi. Records say that he tore across the battlefield like a ball lightning, turning anyone who drew near - friend and foe alike - into ash. Small wonder, then, that he was feared by his allies.

45.Name: Gravemeister Meira
45.Arts Detail: 6400% Dark DMG (Physical). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

3★.Skill Detail: 1800% Dark DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6400% Dark DMG (Physical). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

45.3★ Lore: A Demon spoken of in La Riizian records. Many lives from all races were lost during the Great War. During this time of strife, records speak of a girl who wandered battlefields with countless gravestones, plucking corpses from the ground. Those who opposed her soon became corpses themselves. Though she always made sure to bury the corpses she borrowed, none exist who can explain her actions.
45.4★ Lore: A Demon girl who fought with the corpses of the Great War's battlefields. Rumor suggests that Meira was searching for materials to return her lost lover to the world of the living. Though once nothing more than a rumor, the discovery of records showing that Meira contacted a spirit talker, and that all of the corpses she buried were Human, have forced the re-evaluation of this once unbelievable story.

46.Name: Phoenix
46.Skill Detail: 1400% Fire DMG (Magic). Chance of Burns Enemy.
46.Arts Detail: 2300% Fire DMG (Magic). Heals all Allies' HP by 80% of ATK.

3★.Skill Detail: 1400% Fire DMG (Magic). Chance of Burns Enemy.
3★.Arts Detail: 2300% Fire DMG (Magic). Heals all Allies' HP by 60% of ATK.

46.3★ Lore: A fiery bird mentioned in legends across Raktehelm, the Phoenix is said to burn itself away at the end of its life in a great flame of reincarnation, reviving itself a few centuries later. This has made the bird a symbol of reincarnation, and an object of faith since time immemorial. In addition to embodying the flame of reincarnation, its rare feathers also have powerful healing properties, making them coveted prizes for any alchemist.
46.4★ Lore: This ruler of Raktehelm's firebirds rarely appears before Humans, and few records exist of it, ancient or otherwise. A divine creature said to rule over reincarnation, the spirits of the dead are led to its temple to await rebirth. For this reason, its appearance presages a large number of souls being led to its temples, causing some regions to fear it as a feathered reaper of souls.

47.Name: Canopus
47.Arts Detail: 7050% Water DMG (Magic). Chance of Freezes Enemy.

3★.Skill Detail: 1750% Water DMG (Magic).
3★.Arts Detail: 7050% Water DMG (Magic). Chance of Freezes Enemy.

47.3★ Lore: A researcher reported the discovery of a massive, underwater temple, and a large scale investigation was soon underway. The team searched far and wide, but no trace of the temple could be found. Just as the researcher was about to be reprimanded for false submissions, a massive structure appeared. What was thought to be an underwater temple was actually the Sea Dragon Canopus, and biologists realized they had a great discovery on their hands.
47.4★ Lore: Canopus with its full power unleashed. During the Great War, Sea Dragons fought with seadwelling Giants for control of the ocean. At one point, the Giants staged a massive invasion of Dragon-controlled territory. What awaited them was Ongordo, alone. With a glance at the oncoming hordes and a mighty roar, it unleashed its hidden power: a powerful blast of freezing air. When the cacophony of battle ended, only Ongordo remained in its frozen surroundings.

48.Name: Logbord
48.Arts Detail: 7100% Earth DMG (Magic). Increases all Allies' Break Power by 20% for 15s.

3★.Skill Detail: 1600% Earth DMG (Magic).
3★.Arts Detail: 7100% Earth DMG (Magic). Increases all Allies' Break Power by 20% for 15s.

48.3★ Lore: A magical puppet created during the Great War. Its usability as a magical weapon was doubted at the time, eventually being placed under the care of an officer deemed too strict for the front lines. The hard-nosed officer and hardwood marionette made a peculiar duo, but they earned a shockingly decisive victory during their first battle. The two earned countless battlefield accolades, but betrayal left them stranded deep behind enemy lines.
48.4★ Lore: Betrayed by a fellow officer, the officer and puppet found themselves finding a desperate battle for survival. When an assassin's bullet put an end to the officer's life, he gave two final orders: protect the earth for those who survive, and live on proudly in his name. Hearing Garrod's last words, the marionette felt an unprecedented sense of loss and a surge of limitless energy sweep through its heart.

49.Name: Melchion
49.Arts Detail: 7250% Light DMG (Magic). Chance of Paralyzes Enemy.

3★.Skill Detail: 1700% Light DMG (Magic).
3★.Arts Detail: 7250% Light DMG (Magic). Chance of Paralyzes Enemy.

49.3★ Lore: When Raktehelm was still unformed and shrouded in darkness, this divine beast is said to have guided Creator to the promised land. The Creator, as a reward, bestowed upon Melchion beautiful rainbow feathers. Legends like this speak to the reverence this divine beast of guidance has received since ancient times. Even now, travelers carry talismans inscribed with Melchion's seal: all part of long standing tradition based upon legends such as these.
49.4★ Lore: Melchion's evolved form boasts four massive, beautiful feathers, inspiring dumbstruck awe in all who bear witness to it. After war broke out between Gods and Demons, Spinicios was ordered to the frontlines, unleashing powerful surges of lightning that cleaved the Demonic armies in twain. Those who witnessed the battle describe it as being like a black thundercloud being split open by a single ray of light.

50.Name: Afradohl
50.Arts Detail: 7400% Dark DMG (Magic). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

3★.Skill Detail: 1800% Dark DMG (Magic).
3★.Arts Detail: 7400% Dark DMG (Magic). Chance of Blinds Enemy.

50.3★ Lore: Afradohl is a dark Dragon that once controlled a large swath of land. One day, a swordsman entered its territory, and at the end of a fierce battle, Afradohl lay spent and defeated. A lone Demon appeared then, offering power enough to exact revenge in exchange for signing a pledge to always do the Demon's bidding. After a moment's uncertainty, Afradohl agreed, being reborn as a dark creature burning with revenge.
50.4★ Lore: After being resurrected by the power of necromancy, Afra-Dragim was bound with a chain ensuring he follow his contract, along with regulating his powers and thoughts. He nonetheless rampaged across countless battlefields in search of the swordsman who felled him in the first place, until there! At last! Though his foe fought for the Demons, a great surge of power snapped the chain, and Afra-Dragim found his vengeance at last.

51.Name: Flame Axe Fiana

3★.Skill Detail: 1500% Fire DMG (Physical).
3★.Arts Detail: 6300% Fire DMG (Physical).

51.3★ Lore: An Isliidian soldier, Fiana fought in many battles prior to the start of the Ancient War, becoming squad commander despite her humble upbringing. As such, she felt a profound sense of loyalty toward her home country and resented those who spoke negatively of Isliid. Known as the "Dog of the Empire," she nonetheless won many fans with her beauty, and came to be known among allies as the "Flame Axe Princess" - a name she hated.
51.4★ Lore: A soldier who fought for Isliid during the Ancient war. When future Blade Master Clyde became knight commander, no one complained more than Fiana. Not because she resented him as a fellow commoner, but because she doubted his sense of responsibility. When he abandoned his command and headed to the battlefield, Fiana gave chase in a rage. Then she saw how he fought, counting herself as one of his compatriots from then on.

52.3★ Lore: A pirate who ravaged the seas near Bamint, attacking warships regardless of affiliation and plundering, food, ammo, and treasure. Though attacks on civilian vessels were rare, Grafl was never popular among the common people, perhaps because of his condescending and arrogant attitude. Neither race nor class would spare you from his verbal barbs, and he only laughed harder when he saw discomfort in others.
52.4★ Lore: After the start of the Ancient War, Grafl focused his attacks solely on Bamint warships to assist his friend, the wandering gunslinger Void, on his mission. Though this eventually led to a clash with Bamint's navy, Grafl was able to amass a mighty fleet of his own with help from other pirate crews, making him a household name overnight. It also supposedly spurred one of the Blade Masters into action as well...

53.3★ Lore: There was a Gramenian military officer who ascended the ranks with alarming speed prior to the start of the Ancient War. His skills as a mage were considerable, but he put in the most work manipulating the war. His squad was renowned for appearing when least expected, clinching countless battles. Known as an Illusionist, Zechs rose all the way to the top of the chain of command prior to the start of the war.
53.4★ Lore: A Gramenian strategist who commanded forces during the Ancient War. Though many military records speak of his victories, what stands out most is his work alongside future Blade Master Arth in a battle against Demons. Having disadvantaged militarily, Zechs clandestinely contacted Arth, an old friend, to provide backup from the Divine Army. Having to rely on such schemes to achieve victory did not delight Zechs, however.

54.3★ Lore: At the beginning of the Great War, rumors began to spread of a girl who used a Machine weapon, a "machine gun-esque vehicle," to soar across the sky and deliver letters across battlefields. Soldiers took aim at her, surmising that these letters contained military secrets, but she just shot them down and kept going. In fact, those envelopes didn't contain military secrets, but love letters from every race, every land.
54.4★ Lore: A courier girl willing to cross battlefields to deliver her letters. With rumors spreading of her across all the races, many began entrusting her with letters praying for the safety of family members following the end of the war. When a Demon attempted to take advantage of her services for military reasons, Ameru flew into a rage, raining bullets and expletives on the fiend's battalion until her friend Feena intervened.

55.3★ Lore: Orochi. A name that inspired awe in the masses prior to the start of the war. Though Human in form, Orochi sought power, donning countless relics to do battle, and many say they felt a powerful nobility from within his stunning presence. Many swordsmen challenged him in search of glory, but all were struck down. He also refused to criticize his opponents, even if they chose to employ underhanded techniques.
55.4★ Lore: After the start of the Ancient War, Orochi ended his training to offer his services to a Demon squadron. His decision to take up the blade against Humans inspired both surprise...and fear. Orochi didn't fight against Humans, however, choosing to point his blade exclusively at Gods. No records remain of his final moments, however, perhaps because people viewed his very existence as a sin against the Gods.

56.3★ Lore: A flame Dragon that reigned over Famelle Rock. Boasting overwhelming strength, Dargeon lived impulsively, trampling others without a thought. One day, a lone swordsman appeared to challenge Dargeon, who dismissed the challenger out of hand as a feeble Human. But something unexpected happened. The swordsman - Clyde - gave the dragon his first taste of defeat, and kindling vengeful flames within his heart.
56.4★ Lore: A Dragon burning with revenge against the swordsman Clyde. Following his defeat, Dargeon became fixated on strengthening himself. Sure of his victory, he challenged Clyde to a rematch, only to suffer defeat once more. Bystanders demanded he finish Dargeon off, but Clyde quieted them before congratulating his fallen foe on a fight well fought. Dargeon said nothing, but something within had changed.
56.5★ Lore: Encountering pure strength, as opposed to violence used only to subdue others, led Dargeon to greater heights. When he encountered Clyde up against the wall and surrounded by Demons, he realized the flames of vengeance within his heart were gone. With a flame Dragon behind him and hordes of Demons readying to strike, you'd  think Clyde was finished, but with a roar, Dargeon unleashed a final desperate attack to save him.
56.Awk★ Lore: There exists a legend in Famelle of an unlikely savior: a flame-wrapped Dragon with the majesty of a war god. He who once ravaged land and sky attained true enlightenment after his second duel with a master swordsman. Later, when the swordsman faced peril in the Ancient War, the Dragon appeared to fight alongside him out of respect for his strength as well as his own pride. Once the vast army was repelled, it was said he promised to duel the swordsman once again before soaring back into the endless blue.

57.3★ Lore: The king of water-dwelling Giants, Herck rarely makes contact with surface Giants, quietly ruling within the sea. Harm his subjects, however, and he's liable to bring down a few ships in a fit of rage. He observed from afar when the Great War began, but eventually accepted a request to lend the Giants' strength to the fight. Through his dominion of the seas, he participated in many fierce battles with the Sea Dragons.
57.4★ Lore: The king of the rare water-dwelling Giants, Herck shared dominion with the Sea Dragons prior to the start of the Great War. The two had a relationship that surpassed race, and even Herck's grandfather was a Sea Dragon. His body had dragon features, which were seen as natural and respected at the time, and a source of great power for Herck, but the war pit the two races against each other.
57.5★ Lore: The king of the rarely seen Sea Giants, Herck followed the request to fight alongside the other Giants, and joined the Demon forces. The Sea Giants, always friends to his people, joined the Gods, but he turned his spear against them without hesitation. Though this drew the hatred of the Sea Dragons, the fear they felt towards him proved tactically useful. Damage to both sides was minimal, but scars remained...
57.Awk★ Lore: Grand king of the rare Sea Giants, who ruled the seas during the Ancient War. He had good reason for his unrelenting attacks on his mother's relatives, the Sea Dragons. He wished only to minimize harm to both races. When he sensed the Ancient War would grow only longer and more cruel, his frenzied attack served to restrain the Sea Dragons, and protect his people from further battle. History hides his true intent, though he regrets nothing.

58.3★ Lore: A divine tree that holds the powers of creation and rebirth. Prior to the Great War, a land feud between spirits in Isliid's forests led to the area being razed to the ground. Filled with anguish over the self-inflicted loss of their home, the Spirits offered a prayer to rejuvenate the forest. Hearing this prayer, it is said that Valhalla appeared and restored the forest, which served as a reminder not to repeat the mistakes of the past.
58.4★ Lore: A divine tree with the powers of creation and rebirth. The Great War's battles rended the continents of Raktehelm in two, leading to a natural increase in prayers toward Valhalla. However, few firsthand accounts of such behavior remain. Some despaired, thinking Valhalla had abandoned the eight races after their countless mistakes, but current theories suggest that it was merely preparing its true power for the devastation to come.
58.5★ Lore: A divine tree representing the world's will. Toward the end of the Great War, with the once-beautiful world of Raktehelm a mere shadow of its former self, Valhalla appeared at last in the skies over a raging battle and released the totality of its power. The world was suffused in a radiant light which eventually faded. The devistation brought upon by the war may have rid the surviors of many things, but it did not take away the ground beneath their feet and the air that they breathe. Thus making way for peace to return once again.
58.Awk★ Lore: A divine tree from another world with the overwhelming power to create, dominate and destroy life. After quelling the horrors that have plagued the continent, this divine tree suddenly vanished with a white flash to spend eternity somewhere far far away in an unknown land. This divine tree has many beings living upon its exuberant treetops, including the seeds thought to have been destroyed ages ago. When the divine tree annihilated all that life that dwelled in this realm, as if being wished upon the stars, it is thought that such destruction sparked new life to be brought forth.

Beginning its investigation of this new world, he soon detected the presence of unknown lifeforms, who turned out to be the small fairies of the forest. Confirming their lack of hostility, Eden introduced itself and explained his goal: to save his world from utter annihilation.
59.4★ Lore: A mechanical lifeform from another world. EDEN worked with the fairies he met to find some way to save his world, but unfortunately stumbled into Demon territory. To protect the fairies, he disabled the limiters on his functions, unleashing his original power in the process. Though the Demons were defeated, he had exhausted his energy far faster than expected. His time remaining grew shorter by the moment.
59.5★ Lore: With his functions close to ceasing, the worried fairies gave EDEN some of their secret medicine, which also happened to be the substance he was searching for to save his world. Thanking him for being their friend, the fairies gave him all of their medicine. With the last of his power, he transformed for the long-distance jump back to his world. Even now, the legend of these fairies who saved the metal traveler from another world persists.
59.Awk★ Lore: The metal traveler, EDEN, succeeded in his quest to save his world from utter destruction. With the power of a particular secret medicine, he managed to rid his world of the pollution that plagued it and return it to its verdant glory. And so it is thought that the ark of steel had finally fulfilled his duty. However, to send the benevolent fairies home safely, EDEN set sail once again off into the stars. Legend has it that the stars weren't the only thing shining that night.

The Demon military moved to dispatch the criminal, but the killings ended before they were able to ascertain his whereabouts. Rumors began to spread that the mad knight was a new military weapon or just a conspiracy made up by other races. One thing was certain: he was far stronger than your average Demon.
60.4★ Lore: A mad knight spoken of in Demon legend. Just as old rumors began to fade, another incident had happened. The masked knight had attacked the Demon army. Though thrown into chaos, the military beat back the knight with the help of a knight of their own, who described the attacker as a threat, certainly not a Demon, and questionably a living thing. Soon afterward, the masked knight vanished once more.
60.5★ Lore: A mad knight spoken of in Demon legend. Rumors of the masked knight died down after the tumult of the Great War had begun, but he would appear once more at the war's end. After falling into a trap, the Demon platoon was about to meet its end. Then suddenly, the knight appeared and annihilated the encroaching Gods. The Demons rejoiced, but the knight soon turned his sword on them, and in a ghostly voice, his armor said it would devour all their souls.
60.Awk★ Lore: A masked knight spoken of in Demon legend. After countless massacres during the Great War, he had become known as the mad knight. Even those who had survived the bloodshed were engulfed in the insanity of his presence. No one knows where he is now, but if the words of his armor ring true, he will continue to plague the battlefield in search of souls to devour.

As he witnessed Humans dueling each other, he grew intrigued, the passion of people living to their truest potential coming through in the fights between heroes who would one day be known as Blade Masters. He realized what he lacked. And this only made him stronger.
61.4★ Lore: A knight, born among the Gods, who chose to fight for Humans. Though Ragna observed many duels between Humans, he never participated. People only grew aware of his existence and power sometime after the beginning of the great war. Supposedly, he took up the sword to protect innocent children and the elderly who came under attack, telling those responsible not to "spoil his fun" - words remembered even now.
61.5★ Lore: A knight, born among the Gods, who threw his lot in with Humans. During the Great War, Ragna aligned himself with no country, and continued travelling the world to help those in need. He turned his blade not just against Demons, but anyone who dared to harm the weak, inspiring fear in the strong and courage in the oppressed. Always a wellspring of hope, he never offered his name, leaving it blank from the pages of history.
61.Awk★ Lore: A knight of the Gods whose name lives on only as a word of hope. Hailed as a savior in the Ancient War, he was in truth a brave protector of the weak and warrior for justice. And yet, for non-Humans, he was a figure of fear whose name is spoken even today in hushed tones. Today in Raktehelm, none alive know that the mantra of Ragna, spoken in times of deepest distress, is his true name.

Though Human in appearance, her strength was greater than the average God, and she slew countless Demons. Though nothing is written about what she fought for, rumor suggests that she made a deal with the Gods: in return for her power, the Gods used their strength to defeat a country invading Yomi's homeland.
62.4★ Lore: A swordswoman summoned to Raktehelm from another world. Prior to her summoning, it is said that while she was always an expert with the sword, she never had any special powers. In Raktehelm, however, she overflowed with magical energies, and water surrounded her always, protecting her from harm and forming into blades to attack her Demonic foes. And they're still telling stories of how she cut Afradohl's wings...
62.5★ Lore: A swordswoman summoned to Raktehelm from another world. Though she followed orders to fight against the Demons, a fight she had against a certain scythe-wielding Demoness changed her when she realized that her opponent had once been Human, and that the Demons altered people, turning them into weapons. This only made her magic power stronger, and steeled her resolve to defeat the enemies of Humans.
62.Awk★ Lore: A mysterious swordswoman summoned from another world. She once valued loyalty above all, but eventually, she came to doubt her God masters as much as the Demons.  Ironically, the more she doubted, the sharper her blade cut.  But soon, she will find that this power she sought to defend her home will bring even greater tragedy and hatred.  And so she sets out on a journey to discover how to destroy forever her true enemy: War.

The main body is the small module in the center, which controls the other, larger body, but mysteries about its construction abound. The name "Vaid" refers to the apparatus as a whole.
63.4★ Lore: A Machine weapon that fought during the Ancient War, Vaid was developed in secret to oppose the Gods. The large module is designed to excel in combat, while the smaller module is designed to act as the brain. Working together, they obliterated countless foes of every race. Both units have wills, but the large module is unable to move - it can only speak.

In an encounter with an enemy Beast commander, the small module unleashed all of its weapons. The commander managed to survive, but the large module refused to give the finishing attack. "That is your foe. Not mine," it said.

When one of them defended against an all-out barrage, its self-defense system sounded the alarm to retreat, but the soldier's will programmed into its core demanded it bring the battle to a conclusion.

64.3★ Lore: A hero of the Beasts later known as the Azure Saint. Much hope was placed in him from an early age...perhaps because he defeated a lion with his bare hands at age 10. Belying his fierce appearance was a surprising warmth, and his gentle smile provided inspiration for many. One day, word arrived of a Machine attack on a settlement in a nearby region. Unbeknownst to him, one of these machines would influence the rest of his life...
64.4★ Lore: A Beast hero later referred to as the Azure Saint. After the start of the Great War, the Beasts dedicated all of their forces to helping the Gods. Elfalla, too, fought on the front lines as a warrior, achieving many notable battlefield accomplishments, with a silent grace and a sense of propriety that earned him respect - and his second name - from enemy and ally alike. All the while, a Machine weapon continued watching his actions...
64.5★ Lore: A Beast hero renowned as the Azure Saint, Elfalla attempted to put a stop to a machine weapon of mass destruction, only for the weapon to inform him of a great sin he had committed during an earlier mission. Barely managing to escape, Elfalla found his actions clouded, but was stirred to act once more upon seeing his fellow soldiers doing their best to repay him. He would stop at nothing to stop the rampaging weapon.
64.Awk★ Lore: A hero praised as the Empryeal Beast. After realizing his mistake in fleeing from the Machine weapon, he rushed back to the battlefield. Though afraid he was too late to stop the inevitable slaughter, he arrived to see his brothers-in-arms fighting against the menace, empowered by the belief he would return. That was the inspiration he needed to shed his past regrets and face his destined foe.
