65.3★ Lore: The Gods destroyed a Human village suspected of rebelling, and she was a survivor. At six years of age, she left the village to get medicine for her mother, and came back to find only devastation. She was brought in by Demons, and agreed to undergo modification experiments so that she might exact revenge on the Gods. Time passed. By 16, Lily had grown into a Demonic weapon feared by the Gods.
65.4★ Lore: A murderous weapon that fought for the Demons during the Great War, Lily used her enormous scythe to cut down countless Gods. One day, a swordswoman from another world appeared before her, fighting for the Gods. During the fight, the swordswoman tried to speak to Lily again and again, but to no avail. The swordswoman unleashed hidden magical energy to shatter Lily's scythe, promising to save her, someday, somehow.
65.5★ Lore: A murderous weapon that fought for the Demons during the Great War. After losing to the otherworldly swordswoman, Lily sought even greater power, and used forbidden Demonic arts to form a pact with the reaper. With unimaginable strength and a new scythe, Lily returned to the battlefield... but her mind was slowly being consumed by the reaper. Those who survived described Lily as the reaper incarnate, desperately searching for her mark.
65.Awk★ Lore: An opponent of the Gods in the Ancient War who was called the Deathbringer of Corpse Mountain. In truth, she was a Human girl who turned her hatred into a continual search for power. Once the Deathdealer had her target, she would pursue it without cease, even to death. Once, when she came again against a swordswoman who had ducked her demonic sickle once before, she took on the demeanor of a death-dealing force of nature to kill her foe. For some reason, the swordswoman merely complained under her breath and readied her sword. History does not record what happened next.

66.Name: Fire Fairy "Moug"
66.1★ Lore: Fairies born from flame, one of the five elements comprising Raktehelm. Many are extremely curious, and hold a friendly demeanor toward Humans, one of the subjects of their curiosity. It is said that borrowing the pure power of the flame within them can unlock the hidden power of hero souls. Because they prefer harsh environs such as volcanoes and deserts, only seasoned adventurers can hope to encounter one.

67.Name: Water Fairy "Aquala"
67.1★ Lore: Fairies born from water, one of the five elements comprising Raktehelm. Because of their cheery and outgoing personalities, adventurers don't need to try very hard to find them. It is said that borrowing the pure power of waters within them can unlock the hidden power of hero souls. Preferring watery environs such as lakes and rivers, they're nonetheless difficult to find in oceans. It seems they don't like seawater...

68.Name: Wood Fairy "Medy"
68.1★ Lore: Fairies born from wood, one of the five elements comprising Raktehelm. They live in the depths of the forests, and have easygoing,  laid back personalities. Their calming voices are said to cause an intense drowsiness in adventurers. By the time they wake up, the Medy is already gone, giving them an elusive reputation. Borrowing their pure power may unlock the hidden power of hero souls.

69.Name: Light Fairy "Cura"
69.1★ Lore: Fairies born from light, one of the five elements comprising Raktehelm. It is said that borrowing the pure power of the light within them can unlock the hidden power of hero souls. With tough, hardworking demeanors, Cura have a tendency to lecture, causing headaches for many an adventurer. Guilds considered adding a Cura conversation section to their exams, but it was omitted when the Cura started lecturing the testers.

70.Name: Dark Fairy "Hoog"
70.1★ Lore: Fairies born from darkness, one of the five elements comprising Raktehelm. It is said  that borrowing the pure power of the darkness within them can unlock the hidden power of hero souls. Nocturnal in nature, Hoogs enjoy the night and dark, dank areas but they don't necessarily dislike bright spaces. They take a slightly uncooperative attitude with adventurers, but are caring at heart.

71.Name: Fire Eidolon "Grothe"
71.2★ Lore: An elusive spirit that appears and disappears at whim. Originally an immaterial primeval spirit, Grothe takes form by merging with the power of the elements, and is ensconced in a mantle of flame. Even now, it is believed that desert mirages hold Eidolons within. Borrow an Eidolon's strength, and it should be possible to draw out even more of a hero soul's strength.

72.Name: Water Eidolon "Rivelle"
72.2★ Lore: An elusive spirit that appears and disappears at whim. Its powerful elemental force can make hero souls even more powerful. Rivelles drape themselves in swirling masses of water, and move with the mist. For this reason, sailors refer to the mists that fall over sailing routes as Eidolon Causeways, and tradition dictates that ships never cross them, instead opting to find another route or shortcut.

73.Name: Wood Eidolon "Medeus"
73.2★ Lore: A elusive spirit embodying the elemental power of wood, Medeus has been thought to provide romantic blessing since time immemorial. Carry one of the flower petals from its tail, it's said, and you'll surely meet your soulmate. Small wonder, then, that so many non-adventurers search for Medeus too. Surprisingly, Medeus doesn't seem to mind being the subject of such chases, and happily gives up its petals to those who seek them.

74.Name: Light Eidolon "Selion"
74.2★ Lore: A formless primeval spirit that mingled with lightning elements to become corporeal. Riding in on what appear to be clouds, Selions are oft thought of as the bearers of storms. Rumor once suggested that Selions were easier to find on stormy days. Adventurers would load up on metal gear, set out to find a Selion... and be promptly struck by lightning. Shortly thereafter, guilds began mandating courses on choosing sensible equipment.

75.Name: Dark Eidolon "Dagh"
75.2★ Lore: An elusive spirit that appears and disappears at whim. Though Eidolons are rare by nature, Daghs - who prefer the nocturnal hours - are particularly difficult to find, earning them the title of Most Elusive Eidolon. Stoic and cautious by nature, they're unlikely to help those who do manage the feat of finding them. Because they embody the power of darkness, adventurers in search of Daghs battle most with sleep deprivation.

76.Name: Fire Tectonus "Govan"
76.3★ Lore: A spirit of the earth that underwent a change in form after countless aeons. Its overwhelming physical presence gives the impression of a volcano moving of its own volition. One theory describes them as the embodiment of the earth's rage, and countless legends speak of incidents in which a wrathful Govan burns everything to cinders. With its mad power of flame, it can cause a hero soul's power to ascend to that of the Gods.

77.Name: Water Tectonus "Pacura"
77.3★ Lore: The spirit of the earth takes unique form after countless aeons. Embodying the elemental power of water, Pacuras, with their fierce, glacier-like stature, freeze even the surrounding air. Some researchers suggest that Pacuras follow the will of the Gods, and have been sent to freeze all of Raktehelm in a coffin of ice. With its glacial freezing power, it can cause a hero soul's power to ascend to that of the Gods.

78.Name: Forest Tectonus "Ogohl"
78.3★ Lore: A massive earth spirit whose very body could serve as a continent. During the Great War, when Isliid brought war to a deep forest, massive quakes assaulted their forces, the very earth splintering and rising beneath their feet: they had been fighting on top of Ogohl the entire time. Some were tossed off, while others tumbled into the chasm below. After Ogohl left, all that remained was a battlefield devoid of victors and silence.

79.Name: Light Tectonus "Kira"
79.3★ Lore: A light spirit that underwent a change in form. Suffused in a blinding light, Kira is described as providing a second sun to any land its visits. Its light illuminates all, exposes all. Those with the slightest darkness in their heart find it too much to bear, falling to their knees without resistance.  With its unerring brilliance, it can cause a hero soul's power to ascend to that of the Gods.

80.Name: Dark Tectonus "Worg"
80.3★ Lore: A spirit of the earth that has absorbed the power of darkness over countless aeons. With its massive body, Worg is said to be the darkness of the night given form. Though legend states that those who touch it are returned to nothingness, this is just a side effect of Worg's ability to induce fear of the dark in all who look upon it. With its all-encompassing darkness, Worg can cause a hero soul's power to ascend to that of the Gods.

81.Name: Fire Dragon God "Magnid"
81.4★ Lore: One of the once awed and respected guardian deities of the Dragons. With power over flame, Magnid was born from the Creator's eternal flame, and Dragon legend has long spoken of the incredible power that comes to those who shower in Magnid's blood. Many have challenged Magnid, but no recorded instance of survivors have yet been found. The eternal flame within its wings may just give a great spirit power surpassing the Gods themselves.

82.Name: Water Dragon God "Ur-Megia"
82.4★ Lore: One of the once awed and respected guardian deities of the Dragons. With power over water, Ur-Megia was born from the Creator's spiritual spring, and its blood is said to draw out one's latent abilities. The power of the everchanging waters is the power to influence all living things, and it is said all extinct races are those that lost the providence of Ur-Megia.  The primeval power within its wings may just give a hero soul power surpassing the Gods themselves.

83.Name: Forest Dragon God "Romilia"
83.4★ Lore: One of the once awed and respected guardian deities of the Dragons. With power over the forests, it was born to serve as protector of the world tree. When a war broke out in pursuit of the world tree's power, Romilia's angry howl shook the entire world, stirring the trees to action, and bringing a swift end to the war. The primeval power within its wings may just give a hero soul power surpassing the Gods themselves.

84.Name: Light Dragon God "Ah'ak"
84.4★ Lore:
One of the once awed and respected guardian deities of the Dragons. With power over light, Ah'ak is said to have been born alongside Vajra at the dawning of the world. According to Dragon legend, when the souls of the world's creatures grow impure, Ah'ak's roar will mark the world's final moments.
The primeval power of eternal light within its wings may just give a hero soul power surpassing the Gods themselves.

85.Name: Dark Dragon God "Vajra"
85.4★ Lore: One of the once awed and respected guardian deities of the Dragons, Vajra is said to have been born alongside Ah'ak at the dawning of the world. With power over the night's darkness, Vajra is tasked with finding deeply sinful souls during the final judgement. Wicked souls are swallowed up in Vajra's unending darkness, where they wander in eternal twilight. The eternal darkness within its wings may just give a hero soul power surpassing the Gods.

89.Name: Defmon
89.3★ Lore: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Though Spirits traditionally excel in magic and healing abilities, battles against other races naturally led to the rise of Spirit defense specialists, with the Defmons being toughest of all. They can withstand strikes from the hardiest of foes, routing the advance of countless assaults. A hero soul that attains their sturdy durability will come even closer to mastering the art of defense.

90.Name: King Defmon
90.4★ Lore: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Defmon that accumulates significant experience earns the title of King. They offer impregnable defense to any unit they lead, keeping enemies at bay no matter how powerful they may be. This puts them odds with their offensively-focused Kilmon brethren, however. A hero soul that acquires a King's power will become that much more an expert in the art of defense.

91.Name: Defmon God
91.5★ Lore: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A King who protects its allies ascends to Godhood. Because of a God's ability to win battles without harm coming to any of its allies, earning it praise from even non-combatants. Seafarers worship Defmon Gods as protectors of the sea lanes. A hero soul that acquires the indomitable power of a God will be that much closer to attaining the pinnacle of defense.

92.Name: Tufmon
92.3★ Lore: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Tufmons are endurance personified, and are said to walk for three days straight without stopping as part of their training. The endurance they attain allows them to provide support and fight without so much as breaking a sweat. A hero soul that attains their power will become that much more persistent, that much more the spirit of endurance itself.

93.Name: King Tufmon
93.4★ Lore: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Tufmon whose toughness has been recognized receives the title of King, and assumes this form. They frequently serve as arbitrators when Kilmons and Defmons butt heads, often ending up worse for wear in the process. Because only Tufmons can fulfill this role, however, they're essential to the squad. A hero soul that attains a King's power reaches a greater understanding of endurance.

94.Name: Tufmon God
94.5★ Lore: A Tufmon that accumulates years of experience transforms into a God. During a castle siege, when Kilmons and Defmons argued for their respective philosophies, Tufmon suggested persuading the ramparts to their cause. The ploy worked, and the castle opened its gates without violence, and the Kilmons and Defmons had to acknowledge they'd been outdone. A hero soul that attains the power of a God may just become endurance personified.

95.Name: Golcat
95.3★ Lore: Adventurers are likely to encounter these tiny, tired-looking cat creatures during their travels. But don't let your guard down: Golcats are Gods, and acting like they're weak to lure in unsuspecting adventurers and steal their wallets is what they're all about. Get too close, and they'll grab your Gren and run off with a triumphant look on their face. Golcat attacks have been increasing in recent years

96.Name: Golcat King
96.4★ Lore: A Golcat with a little money saved up starts wearing a crown like they own the place, but it's still the same Glan-obsessed Golcat inside. Adventurers who see this puffed-up fat cat tend to assume their wallets are safe... just before having their wallet stolen by them. And good luck catching up to them! They're faster than your average Golcat. There are rumors of a Golcat hideaway, but the details are sketchy.

97.Name: Golcat God
97.5★ Lore: A very, very, rich Golcat. But what can change the nature of a Golcat? Not money, that's for sure. It may wear a lot of fancy jewelry, but it does not live a fancy lifestyle. The Golcat's hoarding was long seen as an inborn biological trait, but recent research indicates that they may be accumulating money for some kind of purpose, though what that purpose might be remains unclear.

98.Name: Metal Egg
98.3★ Lore: A rare, metallic lifeform that accumulates large amounts of knowledge within its shell. A hero soul that merges with it gains its knowledge as experience, making them sought-after targets for adventurers. However, there is much that is not known about its ecology and behavior, making their capture extremely difficult. Because of this, areas where Metal Eggs are spotted frequently become adventurer shanty towns overnight.

99.Name: Metal Chicken
99.4★ Lore: A Metal Egg that accumulates even more knowledge grows into a Metal Chicken. Hero souls that merge with them gain an incalculable amount of experience. They're far faster than Eggs, meaning that even if you manage to spot one, actually capturing it is another question entirely. After the struggle of capturing a Metal Chicken, many adventurers find themselves emotionally attached and unable to let them go.

100.Name: King Metal Chicken
100.5★ Lore: Gaze upon the Metal Chicken's perfected form. It has absorbed all the world's knowledge, and attained tremendous size as a result. You may think its metallic body would be lumbering and slow, but it can still fly, making it just as hard to catch as before. A hero soul that merges with a King Metal Chicken gains power equal to decades of training. An adventurer only needs one chicken to become a king themselves.

101.1★ Lore:
A new recruit at the Isliid Adventurer's Guild. An orphan from the surrounding area, Rayas has been friends with imperial knight Roy for as long as he can remember. His interest in history and ancient ruins inspired him to become
an adventurer, and he dreams of making a never-before-seen historical discovery. His skills with a sword are above average, but Roy often chastises him for a lack of effort.
101.2★ Lore: A new recruit at the Isliid Adventurer's Guild. An orphan from the surrounding area, Rayas has been friends with imperial knight Roy for as long as he can remember. His interest in history and ancient ruins inspired him to become an adventurer, and he dreams of making a never-before-seen historical discovery. His skills with a sword are above average, but Roy often chastises him for a lack of effort.
101.3★ Lore: An adventurer from the Isliid Adventurer's Guild, Rayas became involved in the battle against the Demons after encountering the amnesiac Iris during a training exercise with Ganan, his guildmaster. While protecting Iris, the power to summon the spirits of ancient heroes awoke within him, allowing him to successfully summon one of the legendary Blade Masters. His abilities with sword and summon will only grow stronger.
101.4★ Lore: During his travels to defeat the Demons, Rayas encountered the Demon Suppression Corps composed of members from the Great Nations. His old friend Roy, a member of the imperial knights, is there as well, and the group's strength proves inspiring enough to further draw out his latent abilities (not that he noticed). Now a part of the Corps, Rayas returns to his journey with expectations of further growth.
101.5★ Lore: An adventurer journeying with friends to end the Demon menace. Contrary to his great strength, few know of his name and exploits, but even the handpicked warriors he journeys with have their eye on him. Real experience has sharpened his talent with a sword, and he's managed to summon not just Blade Masters, but incredible heroes from all of the eight races. Rayas still wants more, however, and so his journey continues.
101.Awk★ Lore: A member of the Reigrad branch of the Adventurers' Guild. Although his contributions in ending both the Second Battle of Gormarey and the Bamint Princess' uprising earned recognition from key international figures, he is far from a household name. His self-taught bladework is, according to a friend with the imperial army, at major officer level. While journeying through La Riiz to defeat the Ancients, he unlocked the memories of the knight within Grand Scale and thus the blade's true power.

102.4★ Lore: A mysterious amnesiac girl, Iris came under attack by monsters outside the Isliidian town of Reigrad and was saved by Rayas. Roy, a member of the imperial knights, tasked Rayas with her protection, perhaps because he knew the Demons were after her. She's aware of her Godly origins, but is still unable to fully control the powers that reside within her.
102.5★ Lore: A divine girl who has the power to break down the barriers surrounding Gods. Though Iris was unaware she possessed such a rare power, she was discovered by a Demon and held as a research subject for anti-God weaponry. Profound in their cruelty, Iris lost her memories as a result of the experiments, but eventually managed to escape. Her encounter with a young man awakened her true power further.

103.4★ Lore: An old friend of Rayas chosen by the Great Nations for its Demon Suppression Corps, Roy is the commander of Fenrir, the third unit of the imperial knights. Many were opposed to Roy becoming commander, due to his youth and lowborn status, but he attained the position with the support of the Emperor and Empress. He was supposedly tasked with such a dangerous mission by the nobility, who despise him.
103.5★ Lore: A knight of Isliid traveling with his allies to eliminate the Demon menace, Roy knows the secret concealed in Raktehelm's history, and seeks a world in which all races can live as equals. Though he once attempted to force a way forward, his way of thinking gradually became more flexible as he fought against the Demons with his friends. When light reached his stubborn heart, he was freed in the truest sense of the word, unleashing his true potential.
103.Awk★ Lore: After the mortal combat at Sealed Fortress Gormarey, he has changed his actions. He has been leaving the subhead in charge, taking action on his own, and training even harder than before. For those who know Roy, they see him as if he decided something and is working vigorously towards that. Few know the faces he shows to his best friend. A huge ambition in his heart he will continue becoming stronger and believe his path he chosen.

104.4★ Lore: Vice-commander of the Bamint knight order "Rose Garden" and member of the Demon extermination squad. Though a princess, she chose the life of a knight instead. Mira refuses to mince words and has a strong sense of justice, resulting in her often acting impulsively and ignoring the actions of others. This has made her some enemies, but her willingness to defend the weak has made her friends to spare.
104.5★ Lore: Third princess of Bamint, who travels with her allies to defeat the Demon menace. She ignored the opinions of Bamint's upper echelons, who didn't want to oppose the Demons, and joined the Demon Suppression Squad on her own. She seems aware of the rumor that they let her join just to get rid of her. She finds it difficult to live true to herself while travelling with others, and will continue forcing her way forward to find a place she can call home.
104.Awk★ Lore: She felt she became stronger ever since the battle at Gormarey, the incident after, and the encounter with numerous people. Her weakness, her goals, what she could only do... these were the things she did not know before. At the same time, she noticed this, she understood that extraordinary possibilities were within her. That enormous power will become the hope of light in this dark world.

Fen is a tactical genius, and trusted more than the president of his own country, but his tendency to vocalize harsh opinions has earned him many enemies. His talents made him head of General Staff by his 29th birthday, but the sweeping reforms he later made to the military drew the ire of the top brass. He proposed the Corps and joined it of his own volition.
105.5★ Lore: The Gramenian head of General Staff who worked to defeat the Demonic threat. After the destruction of the Demon Suppression Corps, Fen returned to Gramenia and acted to protect his position, drawing harsh criticism from his opponents. Knowing the threat the Demons pose, however, forced Fen to do everything to retain his position. When someone who understands the situation appears, he'll finally have the freedom to command as he sees fit.
105.Awk★ Lore: The current head of General Staff for Gramenia became a skilled commander despite his underprivileged childhood. Having already changed his whole life to achieve power and status, this stern man once again begins to change when he meets an adventurer who offers the same words he heard in his childhood. Now, his enemies defeated and the strength he sought in hand, he begins little by little to gain control over the power sleeping within him, for his own sake and for those who count on him.

He acquired his jeweled blade Reudo Magus  after slaying a dark dragon long ago.
106.5★ Lore: A Famellian hero who fought to defeat the Demonic threat. Besides his experience fighting countless victorious battles, his words and actions ooze strength and dependability: small wonder everyone in the Demon Suppression Corps trusts him so much. Despite his age, the indomitable magnificence of his old hand will only grow stronger as he journeys with the younger generation. Proof that heroes don't always look the part.

No one can be as strong as this veteran thus his name will continue to shine as a hero.

Though her voluptuous appearance has engendered many rumors, she acknowledges none of them. The only thing certain about her is that anyone who brings up the subject of marriage to her will never mention the word ever again.
107.5★ Lore: A mage from La Riiz who fought to end the Demonic menace. She has an upbringing she'd prefer not to bring up, and had a tendency to distance herself from others. It's not just her powerful magic, but her long-buried ability to feel for others that is her source of strength.
107.Awk★ Lore: A sorcerer who chose to embrace the darkest parts of the Magus Empire of La Riiz. Her particular abilities and tendency toward rash, independent action invited dangerous misunderstandings. She fell into a trap, straining the faith of her friends, yet the unwavering trust of the adventurer broke through to her, and she resolved to face up to her past. Her sorcery thus broke away from her shadowy past to become something brilliant, something greater, something to protect those she held dear.

The strongest and most prominent of the revived Demons, he assumed command over Grad and Nier as  subordinates. He sought to fully resurrect the Demons, but was defeated by Rayas and his allies.
108.5★ Lore: After falling to Rayas and company, Ragsherum dedicates his life to the resurrection of the Demon Generals. Though a Demon, he possesses something resembling a chivalric dedication to his cause, and a high degree of devotion to the Generals. Though he doesn't destroy or kill for sport, he will pursue mass slaughter if it would achieve his goals. He's wary of Humans, who now rule Raktehelm despite being the weakest race during the Great War.

However, since they considered power the most, they never worked as groups and fought against themselves. One day Ragsherum had suppressed all the others and started his plan to revive Auge at Gormarey. Not only that, he desired to get to the heart of Humans, the winner of the Ancient War, and to put them in fear and despair.

A brutal lover of destruction and combat, Grad obsessively chases Rayas and his friends.
109.5★ Lore: After continuously suffering defeat at the hands of Rayas and his friends, Grad will do anything to win. Cooperating with Nier and using the power of the Iris copies, Grad is ultimately destroyed by a half-awakened Rayas. 109.Awk★ Lore: A Demon warrior who once served under Sin Emperor Giaveil, slaughtering countless God soldiers. After being defeated by a Human swordsman, Grad couldn't contain the raging fury inside him. His hatred seethed. "No one surpasses me and lives," he thought, a common notion among Demons, who take pride only in power. Now Grad knows just what to do. "All that's left is to kill him and prove my strength," Grad laughs, grabbing his magic spear.

However, her decisions are unique, so people around her think she moves depending on her feelings.
110.5★ Lore: Being defeated several times by Rayas and the others, she calmly reviewed her cause of it, and planned to fight with Grad who she was at odds. This was best exemplified when she joined forces with a rival Demon after her first defeat at the hands of a Human adventurer, yet that humiliation proved to be in vain. The losses continued to mount and a new emotion took hold of her heart, changing her objective from selfless duty to personal revenge.

He suffered from a terrible injury during his failed operation with the knights, making it impossible for him to unleash his full power.
111.5★ Lore: Everyone thought he was unable to use his full power because of his unhealed injuries. However, he had actually fully recovered from it long ago. However strong his enemies, his allies will always be able to depend on his smiling courage.
111.Awk★ Lore: The most powerful warrior of the Adventurer's Guild and guild master of Reigard branch. Throughout the days at Reigard, Ganan interacted with many young adventurers. Being touched by their passion, he reconsidered his own path, together with the unforgettable mistake of his past and the meaning of being a guild master now... Embracing the failure of his past, he takes a step forward to protect the heroes of tomorrow.

This means he can't take massive military orders like other blacksmiths, instead tailoring his work to individuals. He's also extremely picky about materials, and will fight monsters to get what he wants. He's drinking buddies with Ganan.

His expertise is known throughout nearby kingdoms, and though many would-be blacksmiths have begged to apprentice under him, only three have met his rigid standards. This means he can't take massive military orders like other blacksmiths, instead tailoring his work to individuals. 112.5★ Lore: Though originally a highborn child of Bamint, Gilliam decided he didn't want to live according to his parents' whims and left the house at age 16 to travel the world. After falling in love with a certain blacksmith and demanding to become their apprentice, he heard tales of the legendary weapons used by the 3 Blade Masters. He set off on a journey to amass materials to forge an even greater weapon, and the trail led him to set up shop in Reigrad.
112.Awk★ Lore: A skilled craftsman of Reigrad. Mesmerized by the art of smithing from a young age, he honed his craft diligently. The color of the fire, the sound of forging steel, the weight of the sledgehammer in his hands are constantly changing phenomena that, even after many years of disciplined practice, never extinguish his passion. His legacy is an inspiration not only for other blacksmiths but for artists of all kinds.

Though she's currently only 13, she's far more dignified and regal in presence than Rayas.
113.5★ Lore: Called a genius, her light magic are powerful enough to be termed "miracles," but she still has moments that reveal that yes, she is in fact a teenager. The moments when Liese acknowledges her own youth are moments that cause her heart to soar, unleashing ever greater power and potential.

Since some time or another, an adventurer and his friends started visiting her and telling stories of their journeys. The stories sometimes exciting and at other times terrifying. What kind of judgement should she make as a follower of the Light God? This question and responsibilities  led her to a higher dignity and more powers as a priestess.

Usually calm and polite, Est is quick to anger if someone starts causing trouble, exacting discipline at swordpoint. Those who know her are reminded during moments like these that yes, she really is Ganan's daughter.
114.5★ Lore:

On the other hand, her mother helps her out secretly. She feels that unlike her expectations, the distance of the two are getting even farther. Yet, she still aims for a higher goal. This pure heart releases the strong power from her parents.

115.3★ Lore: Proprietress and head chef of the Firecat's Den in Reigrad, which boasts flavors and prices that make it popular among the common people. Her father, who is also her teacher, is currently retired due to injury, but hailed from a family of high-class Bamantian restaurateurs. Displeased with the idea that his food would only be enjoyed by the rich, he left on a journey in search of freedom.
115.4★ Lore: Proprietress and head chef of the Firecat's Den in Reigrad, which boasts flavors and prices that make it popular among the common people. Her father, who is also her teacher, is currently retired due to injury, but hailed from a family of high-class Bamantian restaurateurs. Displeased with the idea that his food would only be enjoyed by the rich, he left on a journey in search of freedom.
115.5★ Lore: Not only did Sophie's father teach her how to cook, he taught her how to acquire ingredients all on her own. Her training included how to lay traps, how to traverse dangerous environments, as well as how to fight. Even Ganan was impressed at how capable of an adventurer she'd become. Since she had an extraordinary upbringing, she has extremely high standards when it comes to men. Thus, she has not yet found someone who sets her heart aflutter.
115.Awk★ Lore: As head chef of the Firecat's Den, she works hard to make sure that her customers stay happy and satisfied. However, she tends to furrow her brow when focusing on her craft. This used to bother her, but the words of a novice adventurer made her concerns fly away. "A good meal always puts a smile on your face!" was all she needed to hear to gather herself and head back to the kitchen, motivated as ever.

116.4★ Lore: An alchemist who runs an alchemy shop in Reigrad. Her words and actions are shrouded always in an air of mystery. Though she claims to be from Isliid, it's impossible to determine if this is the truth. What's clear is that she's a very capable alchemist, to the point that she can create anything in existence if given the right materials. She's quite skilled in magic, too, deepening the mystery surrounding her even further...
116.5★ Lore: An incident reveals that Rem is a magician who was once stationed in the Isliidian military. That same incident led to her leaving the army and setting out to become an alchemist. Her goal: to create the Philosopher's Stone and revive the dead. When she found out that the soul she was hoping to revive didn't wish to return to life, she gave up on her original goal, choosing to use both magic and alchemy to enrich the lives of others.
116.Awk★ Lore: She is the greatest of all alchemists who is secretly approaching the world's rule of nature. Having the powers of once trying to revive the dead, she never stands at the stage. This is because she is getting the closest as she can to the truth of alchemy. Possessing the powers to overturn common sense and making the impossible possible, she cannot take the wrong path. With this firm belief, she will generously show her ultimate powers of an achemist to the adventurer standing against the world's danger.

However, a turning point manifested in the form of a lone witch, who sealed his dracosis and returned him to his senses. When he came to, what joined him was his sense of powerlessness and a furious rage.
117.5★ Lore: A half-dragon warrior transformed by a disease known as dracosis. While an encounter with a witch saved him from becoming a mad dragon, the curse of the disease still haunted him. Forced to barely repress his destructive impulses, Arosdea searched battlefields for someone strong enough to stop him. His draconic power was too much to bear, however, and no such savior appeared. He set off to find the witch who sealed his powers.
117.Awk★ Lore: A warrior who gained great power from dracosis. As he fought an archer, the seal placed over his half-dragon self broke and Arosdea realized his true power, but he lost his senses and rampaged to scorch the whole world. Unable to stand by, the witch solved the problem with an ice age. This is now passed down in legends as the Winter of Thaumazein.

118.4★ Lore: One of the six witches in "Grimm Stella," a coven of witches written about in ancient histories, Selia is a master of powerful ice magic, and possesses a reckless personality that sees her curiosity guiding her every action. Oblivious to her surroundings, once she sets her mind to something, it's almost certainly going to cause some serious damage. She caused countless incidents prior to the Great War, receiving the nickname "Witch of Disaster".
118.5★ Lore: Selia travelled the world, eventually encountering a soldier whose life she had inadvertently saved. Bored of his pleas to kill him, she suddenly realized she had a plan. ”He can definitely kill you," she said, pointing at the archer who conveniently walked by. In moments, the dragon soldier and archer began to fight. Happy that her plan had succeeded, she strolled off to observe the furious battle raging on Thaumazein Plain at the peak of summer.
118.Awk★ Lore: The fierce battle ended before the eyes of distant watcher Seria. However, the massive flames of the warriors' final clash spread in a great wildfire, threatening to consume the entire wilderness. Seria saw this, and used her Absolute Zero sorcery. The plains were frozen solid, and the rampaging flames died out. This disaster became known as the Thaumazein Winter, when the grain belt was buried in snow. The truth of what happened is recorded nowhere, but she surely doesn't mind.

119.4★ Lore: A Spirit archer who fought prior to the Great War. A fox child, Toto was taken in by Eleanor, one of the six Great Witches, and spent his days training his archery skills in the depths of the forest. One day, he was ordered by Eleanor to chase down a troublesome witch who was disrupting nature's providence. After leaving the forest and travelling the world, he finally found Selia at Thaumazein Plain. Suddenly, a new, draconic challenger attacked...
119.5★ Lore: An archer who chased after the witch Selia, Ashe Toto was forced into a fierce fight against a newfound assailant. Dodging a furious flurry of slashes and moving in for a counterattack, Toto's skills with the bow were at their sharpest. As the swordsman attacked with all his might, Toto loosed an arrow to end it all... and realized he was going to lose. The explosion from their strikes engulfed him, and everything in his vision suddenly turned pure white...
119.Awk★ Lore: The fiery Thaumazein Plain was once transformed into a frigid wasteland by the Witch of Disaster. The disgrace at being saved by his target and the anger at his own weakness that allowed it awakened the power sleeping within him. He fired an arrow with the whole of that strength, intending to bring the chase to an end. However, all that accomplished was ridding the Plain of her cold magic, making him its unwitting savior.

His hometown suffered a great fire, Though countless innocents fled for their lives in front of him, he could do nothing against the roaring flames. At that moment, a girl suddenly appeared in front of him, summoning a great blizzard to extinguish the fire. From that day forward, Duran abandoned his post as a knight to embark on a journey.
120.5★ Lore: Once a knight, Duran left his post to embark on a journey. As he travelled the world, Duran fought for the powerless in every land, eventually leading to him being renowned as a wandering hero. Needless to say, Duran himself never claimed to be any such thing. One day, he heard rumors of a dread swordsman running rampant across the land. Without delay, he began heading to the area where this murderous monster was rumored to be...
120.Awk★ Lore: Duran encountered the crazed swordsman who was terrorizing the northern towns. From how the warrior wielded his sword with abandon, he knew the weapon had possessed him. After a heated confrontation, the knight suffered near-fatal injuries but not a single innocent was harmed. Ever since, the legend of Duran and his shield spread across the land.

121.4★ Lore: A spellblade who served as bodyguard to Auge, one of the six Demon Generals. Zenon was dedicated to Auge in heart and soul, and would perform any job requested of him, no matter how low, until the day he was imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit. This was all a plot by a Demon commander who was anxious about Zenon's growing power. Furious at this betrayal, he howled revenge, and his magic sword Fah Ode came to him as if in answer.
121.5★ Lore: A Demonic spellblade betrayed by his own people, Zenon used his sword Fah Ode to dismiss the officer who conspired against him... permanently. As the life drained from his body, the officer revealed Auge was partially responsible for carrying out the  betrayal. As hatred welled up in within him, his sword unleashed even greater power, reducing his  surroundings to a mountain of corpses and debris. And he had no idea this was all part of Auge's plan...
121.Awk★ Lore: Zenon loathed the whole world, so took up his cursed sword and made blood rain throughout the land. And then a single knight rose to stop him. The battle that suddenly erupted in the city streets was so fierce it changed the very shape of the land. During the battle, Zenon finally understood the reason his cursed sword came to his hand. And that understanding released the true power of the blade. The attack then unleashed, fueled by the hatred and bloodlust of the blade's will, destroyed everything in the area--including his own life.

122.4★ Lore: A Machine gunner who fought before the Great War. Soleil was originally a little girl's automaton. One day when the girl was out on an excursion, the house came under attack and the girl never returned. Having lost her master, Soleil concluded from the flower petals left by the assailant that the Funereal Bloom was responsible. After a defeat at her hands, Soleil sought out the Dragon blacksmith Rhodia.
122.5★ Lore: A Machine gunner who chases after a witch. After meeting with the Dragon blacksmith, Soleil had the strength she needed, and headed after the witch Pola to have her revenge. Though the two were an even match for each other, Soleil was never built for combat, and her body slowly buckled under the force of her weaponry. Realizing a long fight was out of the question, Soleil disabled the limiters on her weapons, unleashing a final salvo at Pola.
122.Awk★ Lore: A machine gunner with the Demonic Warrior in her sights, locked and loaded, is out for revenge. The strong-willed shooter needs to team up with the Beast Martial Artist and hone her technique. Unaware of her ebbing endurance, she slowly ripped herself apart in battle. Right before her functions halted, the Beast combatant bested the Demon with his martial prowess. After exacting her revenge, fading in and out of consciousness, she cried for the first time in her life.

One day, Saar heard rumors of a gunner seeking revenge against the Funereal Bloom for murdering her master. To confirm this rumor, Saar headed to the Dragon blacksmith who provided modifications to the gunner.
123.5★ Lore: A half-Demon, half-Beast fighter who was once saved by a witch. The blacksmith, who had modified the gunner now hunting the witch, was moved by Saar's story, and taught him traditional Draconic martial arts. From there, he headed to the site of the battle between the witch and the gunner, who was just about to unleash a final salvo. Saar threw himself in front of the witch without hesitation, blocking and negating the incoming salvo.
123.Awk★ Lore: Some time after putting a stop to the battle between the witch and the musketeers, Saar saw that blacksmith to whom he owed so much was feuding with mysterious Demons. When he rushed to the battlefield and learned the truth behind their conflict, Saar's searing rage awakened the slumbering powers of his dual heritage. The witch and musketeers joined the fight against the demons, but the blacksmith fell at the height of the battle protecting Saar. Entrusted with the smith's legacy and with a mighty roar, Saar now unleashes secret Dragon techniques in his war against the Demons and their schemes.

124.4★ Lore: One of the six witches in "Grim Stella," Pola possesses incredible power and is feared as the "Funereal Bloom." With a unique set of values, Pola believed the singing voice of a young Spirit boy she knew was the definition of beauty. However, a bandit she was chasing unleashed a curse on this boy, stealing his voice and vanishing without warning. Having been deprived of that which she loved most, she began an indiscriminate rampage on the world.
124.5★ Lore: A witch feared as the "Funereal Bloom." As her rampage continued, a female Machine appeared before Pola and commenced a furious assault against her. In response, Pola unleashed her previously sealed true power. To her surprise, she realized that she perceived this automaton fighting heedlessly for its life as beautiful. Her lips curled into a smile. As the flames drew closer, Pola slowly closed her eyes.
124.Awk★ Lore: Her protector is a half-Beast half Demon youth who saved her on a whim. She was completely dumbfounded by this, but she used her special plant based defensive magic to protect an overwhelmed automaton that had changed its target to the Demons. Until then, their only choice had been to fight alongside their enemy. And for some reason, this helped her power grow far beyond her previous limits. No one knows how the battle ended or what happened to her later, but the name Witch of Funeral Flowers never appeared in the histories again.

Upon discovering the existence of a Demon god sealed in another world, he sought to make that strength his own. This involved extracting despair and mutual hatred from many powerful individuals. And it was a single witch's despair that opened the throttle on his master plan.
125.5★ Lore: A Demon warrior who works in secret to attain the power of a dark god. Leon's fearful scheme called for filling the world with hatred to undo the god's dimensional bonds. He believed he was close to completion by pitting a certain witch and gunner against each other, but a young Beast fighter intervened to stop their conflict. Furious, Leon approached the meddler to finish the plan personally, but a lone blacksmith stood in his way.
125.Awk★ Lore: A Demon warrior who sought to acquire the power of a dark god. With his original plan foiled, he decided to kill the blacksmith, who had a martial artist apprentice. He hoped the apprentice's anger would be enough to free the evil deity, but it instead brought his ambition -- and his life -- to an ironic end. The pugilist's fist pierced Leon's chest with astonishing strength, killing him before the shock faded from his eyes.

126.4★ Lore: A Dragon mercenary active prior to the Great War, Zoroas participated in countless battles in search of powerful opponents. Though currently known as a master of armed combat, he was once feared only for the destructive power of his iron ball. That is, until he lost it in a battle, prompting him to draw a sword and begin slaying foes immediately. The rumor from that day forward was that the iron ball was merely to keep a limit on his overwhelming strength.
126.5★ Lore: A Dragon mercenary who sought powerful foes, One day, when Zoroas had grown frustrated over a lack of worthy opponents, a God appeared before him. After a brief exchange, this knight burst into a rage, unleashing her jeweled blade's power, but Zoroas simply smiled and met the attack at full strength. This fight was stopped, however, by two Giants and a girl. Readying his furious iron ball, the young girl's magical power soon exploded.
126.Awk★ Lore: At the end of his journey with the Spirit girl, Zoroas confronted a terrible monster and struggled in battle against its magic-devouring maw. When all seemed lost, Zoroas noticed the girl casting a sealing magic spell, completely unguarded. Smiling with abandon, Zoroas turned back to face the Demon beast that was now charging toward the girl. "Whatever it takes to win!" Zororas said to the shocked Spirit girl. It was the first time that Zoroas, someone who had selfishly lived for only to fight and defeat powerful foes in battle, fought instead to protect another.

127.4★ Lore: A knight who was part of a company of God knights in ancient times. She despised being underestimated and was always seen wearing a full suit of armor. As a knight in service to the higher Gods of order, she saw the commands of the higher Gods and order itself as absolute. Her sternness was so great that she would cut down any knight who expressed a lack of faith where they stood. Zechsia, ever loyal, was given a divine mission: to slay a mercenary whose intervention in battles caused chaos and confusion.
127.5★ Lore: As a God knight dedicated to preserving order, Zechsia's rage was directed at a Dragon mercenary who fought and created chaos for his own enjoyment. Unleashing the power of the jeweled sword given to her by the high Gods, she began a furious assault in the name of her divine mission. The battle soon reached a fever pitch. Right as two Giants entered the fray, a tearful young girl appeared and unleashed tremendous magical power, swallowing up all in the vicinity.
127.Awk★ Lore: Zechsia pursued the Dragon mercenary, but grew skeptical of the justness of her orders upon seeing a kind young girl traveling happily with him. Her doubts about slaying the supposedly wicked Dragon were confirmed when she witnessed him fearlessly protecting the girl from a beast. Zechsia drew her sword against the beast to save the wounded mercenary, marking the first time in her entire life that she disobeyed a divine order.

128.4★ Lore: A Human gunner who became renowned prior to the Great War, who uses Nigreid, the Dark Gun, to hunt monsters across the land. Though his actions earned him renown, none knew his reasons for fighting monsters. One explanation is that Zecht's gun became more powerful for every foe he defeated with it. Though he defeated countless monsters, one fateful occasion found him chasing after a fire Dragon...
128.5★ Lore: A gunner who chased a fire Dragon. After witnessing its symbolic destructive power, Zecht began chasing the fire Dragon, eventually cornering it thanks to the help of friends he met along the way. In accordance with the distant promise it made with the self-destructive Dragon, Nigreid unleashed its full power, unleashing a bullet to end all bullets. As the Dragon fell, the Dark gun consumed its soul, shining brightly.
128.Awk★ Lore: The slain fire Dragon resurrected as a flame elemental. Zecht fought back, but its massive power was impossible to endure in his wounded state. Defeat seemed certain until his friends risked their lives to lend him strength. Grateful, he used that additional might to awaken Nigreid's true form, allowing it to absorb the Dragon's flames. By combining that energy with his spirit, it released an awesome blast which destroyed his archenemy for good.

129.4★ Lore: A Spirit mage and member of the "Grim Stella" coven in ancient Raktehelm. Aristela had powerful magic from a young age, and would later be counted among the Six Witches. A bookworm, it's written that she read the entirety of the coven's archives, numbering thousands of books. On a visit to broaden her mind, she heard a rumor of two rampaging Giants. Unable to see the villagers suffer any more, she headed to the Giants' abandoned fortress.
129.5★ Lore: One of the supremely powerful Six Witches. To reform the two troublemaking Giants, she brought them on a journey to help people. As they travelled the world helping those in need, they found two warriors fighting each other. The Giants attempted to intervene, but the situation worsened, dealing huge damage to the surroundings. Aristela tried her best to mitigate the damage, but came to be known as the "Annihilation Witch" instead...
129.Awk★ Lore: While on a journey with her four companions, she heard tell of a beast that would devour the world, and they ventured to find it without pausing for thought. She faced the immensely powerful creature and prepared all her power to unleash a sorcerous attack. Yet the only result was that the monster absorbed the attack and grew even more powerful. Seeing that mere force would not defeat the beast, she focused the power offered by her comrades. Together, they manipulated the ancient power of the seals to banish it to another world, yet the cost was the lives of her comrades.

130.4★ Lore: A Giant warrior who fought prior to the Great War. Zoldes was a famous fighter among the Giants renowned for his many battlefield feats. However, after many years of fighting against other races, he reacted violently to a perceived insult after the end of hostilities and struck down the emissary of another race. Upset about the perceived weakness of his fellow Giants, Zoldes left with his brother Olgeth on a rampage of destruction.
130.5★ Lore: A Giant warrior who went on a rampage before the Great War. One day, a young girl delivered a devastating defeat to him, deflecting all of his mighty attacks with magic. Driven to rage, he unleashed blow after blow, destroying everything around him. When he awoke inside the collapsed castle, he realized the girl had protected him from a falling rock with magic. Admitting his defeat, he asked to travel alongside her from that day forward.
130.Awk★ Lore: Realizing their disadvantage against the Magibeast horde, the elder of the giant brothers decides to fight solo to protect his brother and the young Spirit girl. Possessed by some divine strength, he slaughters the enemy host without letting a single enemy touch the others. After the carnage, he looks to see the girl running towards him, tears in her eyes. He gazes upwards, and with a hearty laugh, falls into an eternal slumber.

One day, a young man appeared, asking about the whereabouts of a Machine she had done upgrades to. She sensed a powerful will behind his words and decided to teach him Dragon martial arts so that he might realize his mission. From that day forward, Rhodia supposedly acted more warmly to others.
131.5★ Lore: A Dragon blacksmith spoken of in legend. She taught a half-Beast and half-Demon fighter Dragon martial arts so that he might save a witch. Rhodia began acting on her own and discovered a dark plot involving the witch. While she went after the young man to make sure he knew the truth, she ended up finding the Demon who was responsible for the plot in the first place. To put an end to things for good, she unleashed the power of her transforming scythe and challenged Leon to a duel.
131.Awk★ Lore: The Dragon blacksmith Rhodia and her former student Saar, a young half-Beast half-Demon man, fought a desperate battle against Demon warrior Leon. When Leon struck down with his great axe, Rhodia rushed in to take the blow for Saar, but she suffered a fatal injury. Rhodia knew that her end was nigh, so she confirmed that her student was safe and gave him the armor that she had spent half her life to create. Afterwards, she smiled contentedly and closed her eyes.

Olgeth alone changed the tide of many battles, but this simply earned him the title of "The Mad Brother." When his brother left the Giants to wander on his own, he followed along without saying much. But an encounter with a young girl affected a great change in his weak-willed heart.
132.5★ Lore: A Giant warrior who made a name for himself prior to the Great War. During his journey, he and his brother were defeated by a girl with incredibly powerful magic. Shocked by this turn of events, Olgeth was filled with an intense desire to help the girl, ultimately deciding to join her on her travels. As he grew more powerful, he would end up saving the girl on countless occasions during their journey.
132.Awk★ Lore: Surrounded by a throng of Magibeast, the Giant brothers and their Spirit companion find themselves vastly outnumbered. Against the older brother's demands to save themselves, the younger brother stands and fights alongside him. With a face of certainty and uncharacteristic defiance, the younger brother asserts, "I'm not leaving my only brother behind." And with that declaration, they face the Demon horde, side by side.

133.5★ Lore:
偉大なる魔族を父に持つ魔嬢。日々侵攻を邪魔する古代の森の守人たる精霊を、父からもらったという自動人形型兵器の力で追い
詰め、ついに主である古竜を引きずり出すにいたる。しかしまったく思い通りにならない古竜に腹を立て、彼女は森ごと焼き払う命令を人形に下した。…はずだった。人形の制御は突然現れた魔術師に奪われ、次の瞬間、虚空に吹き飛ばされていたのは彼女の方だった。
133.Awk★ Lore: 漆黒の翼を持つ誇り高き魔族の令嬢。突如あらわれた魔術師に、彼女は自動人形の制御を奪われてしまう。相手の心を折らんとばかりに自動人形を自在に操り、力量の差を見せつける魔術師。平時の彼女であれば屈していたかもしれない。だが、彼女は臆することなく魔術師を睨みつける。家族を取り戻したい――初めて芽生えた自動人形への純粋な想いが彼女を突き動かしていた。

However, getting involved in the battle between a musketeer and fire dragon, her life changed completely. She fell in love with the musketeer who risked his life to save hers. Believing that he was her soul mate, she decides to follow him.
134.5★ Lore: A girl of Gods who is after a musketeer. The moment she realized her lifesaver is a magical beast hunter, she became one too. Learning how to use whips by her own, she defeated magical beasts one after another. This was only to get closer to the musketeer, but her skills became more powerful by battling beasts. Finally, she found her soulmate... but there was a woman of Beasts next to him.
134.Awk★ Lore: Shadie's questions about the woman the musketeer was with were interrupted by a fire dragon's attack. With her true power awakened by this disruption to her journey to true love, Shadie and the musketeer prevailed over the dragon. However, the musketeer nearly faced his demise after the battle, enveloped by the cursed flames unleashed by his overloaded firearm. In the end, what saved the musketeer from his fate and dispelled the gun's curse was Shadie, who embraced him with open arms even as the dark fire threatened to swallow him whole.

One day, ignoring the pleas of his friends, Rhiothis decided to challenge a powerful Demon solo. Though finally managing to defeat his foe, his friend died protecting him. Lamenting his arrogance, he vowed to raise his friend's now fatherless daughter, sealed his powers, and moved deep into the forest.
135.5★ Lore: A mage who sealed his powers to raise his dead friend's daughter in safety. One day, his beloved adopted daughter ran away. He went looking for her, but hesitated to bring her home after seeing how happy she was. Some time later, when danger had fallen upon her, he unleashed his sealed powers to save her. He continued watching over the child throughout her journey with his gentle yet powerful light from that day forward.
135.Awk★ Lore: The old mage looked up to see his daughter and a soldier under the collapsing cliff. He rushed after them and suddenly remembered her smile from before. Seeing his little girl leave the nest left him feeling sad but grateful since she seemed so happy with the gunman. With both hands raised, he used his magic to save them both from the falling rocks.

However, one day, haunted by a Demon of Destruction, its soul was tortured little by little. The hellish flames that dwelled in it burned not only living beings but also castles and fortresses. With no warning signs, it showed up and destroyed everything that it wished. Thus, Teriodos left its name in history as a symbol of terror.
136.5★ Lore: A Fire Dragon that united with a Demon and turned into an incarnation of destruction. Its powers merged as Teriodos destroyed places here and there. The flames that dwelled inside it flooded, thus where it landed turned the ground into a wasteland. Before long, a lone warrior put an end to the monstrous riot. In its last moments, unable to control itself, it wished for death. However, no one knows the truth...
136.Awk★ Lore: At constant war with its destructive urges, the Fire Dragon decided to allow a Human warrior to determine its fate. Against its own will, the Demon possessing the Dragon forced it to continue his rampage. Through the lens of what little consciousness it had left, it saw the barrel of the warrior's gun and the determination in his eyes. At the ominous sight, the Dragon felt not fear but a sense of relief.

Though his rigorously trained skills with a bow were accurate enough to earn him the nickname "Bullseye," he felt like Reyon was achieving more than him. When a Bamint VIP was assassinated and Reyon volunteered to help search for the culprit, Keiones had to raise his hand too.
137.5★ Lore: A Human knight with impeccably trained archery skills. After realizing that the assassin he was chasing was an old friend of his, Keiones felt conflicted. Not only that, the order had been changed from "apprehend" to "kill." He asked his old knight friend why this didn't give him pause, but his mind was made up. Keiones was still conflicted as he faced his old friend's girlfriend. With his heart pulled in multiple directions, he found himself unable to loose his arrow.
137.Awk★ Lore: As the knight stood still, holding the deeply wounded girl in his arms, the girl muttered, "It's all going to be OK. There will come a day where we can all sit and laugh together again." To put an end to the infighting, she sacrificed herself. And after letting out a grin marked with a hint of sadness, she gently closed her eyes and faded away. With complicated feelings of regret and determination, the knight shed tears over her serene face.

138.4★ Lore: A Spirit mercenary who has roamed all the post-War nations. He was raised in a village in what is now the Principality of Bamint along with his beloved adopted sister Lione, and now they are unrivaled partners in work as well. He usually plays a support role for his attacker sister, but his ever changing attacks are unstoppable, and if he takes the offensive, the enemy forces are doomed. When he learned of danger approaching his home, he and his sister assassinated the ringleader of the plot, a powerful official.
138.5★ Lore: A Spirit mercenary who wields the power of nature. Though wanted for the murder of an official, he explained to the knight pursuing him that the deed was done to protect their home. The knight was not convinced and attacked relentlessly, despite being a childhood friend. Indeed, he once held deep feelings for Lione... And know, the only ones ready to fight are he and this knight. If these two destroy each other, the other 3 present can go on without further death. With that thought, the man readied himself to stop the knight's attack.
138.Awk★ Lore: He had only meant to stop the fighting but inadvertently killed his childhood friend. When he threatened to be overcome by the weight of that loss, a slap from his sister brought him back to his senses. She was bravely holding back tears, which made him realize that death should not be in vain. Bidding a final farewell, he marched onward towards a future without war, a dream they all shared in their youth.

139.4★ Lore: A Beast mercenary who fought many battles after the Ancient War. She was a war orphan, but she had a happy childhood in the Principality of Bamint. Aspiring to become famous, she fought the fiercest battles with her fire and became known as "Lion Fire Lione". She accomplished many missions together with her step-brother Elmessio, but once they accidentally became aware of a secret. In order to prevent the unforgivable plan, the two decided by their own decision to assassinate the key man involved in this plan.
139.5★ Lore: A mercenary who controls fire lions. To undermine a secret plan, she got her hands dirty with the murder of a man. Thus, she escaped to her hometown to hide and was welcomed by a God childhood friend. But soon the chaser found her and unexpectedly turned out to be another childhood friend, a Spirit. She would then explain the reason for the murder, to achieve his understanding, but instead, his suspicion grew even bigger. The battle could not be avoided and the old friends ended up facing each other. The battle came to an end only when the God friend, who had defended her, fell down.
139.Awk★ Lore: The Spirit who slashed his childhood friend was now screaming with the lifeless remains in his arms. After all, he was also one of the orphans grown up in this village. After punching him only once, Lione proclaimed she would fulfill her friend's dying wish and protect their hometown. And then she asked the remaining three childhood friends: "What will you do to accomplish the dream we had as children, and her dying wish?"

140.4★ Lore: A Bamint knight whose name rose to prominence after the end of the Great War. He grew up in a village with other war orphans, and was scouted for his talent, becoming a knight along with an archer friend of his. He improved quickly after joining, always analyzing situations calmly, and rumors spoke of his bright future. When he found out the person he owed his life to had been assassinated, however, he was the first to offer to hunt down the culprit.
140.5★ Lore: A Bamint knight who worked tirelessly to make a name for himself. When he found out that the assassin who murdered the person he owed everything to was an old friend, he didn't so much as bat an eye. Not because he was cold and unfeeling, but because he wanted to ask the assassin why they did it, and possibly allow them to escape. When he heard their reasons, however, he grew enraged. To protect the honor of the deceased, he prepared to slay his old friend himself.
140.Awk★ Lore: He fell into despair when he ended up slaying the person he treasured and wished to protect above all others, but in the end, she merely smiled up at him. She seemed happy if it meant her friends could all be together again. The childhood dream which she left him as she died burned itself into his heart. To defend their village, he decided to help create a country free of discrimination. He returned to his original ambition of finding success in the Principality of Bamint and left his village again.

141.4★ Lore:
A God who protected a certain village after the end of the Great War. To realize their sworn dream, she remained in the village even after her friends had left on their own journeys. Though she was willing to unleash her slumbering power to defend the village, she was fundamentally very calm, and despised conflict. So
calm and kind, in fact, that she was willing to shelter her friends when they became implicated in the grave crime of assassinating one of Bamint's VIPs.
141.5★ Lore: A God who did everything in her power to protect her precious village and childhood friends. She was requested to keep the presence of her old friends, now criminals, a secret. After much soul-searching, she agreed... They were her childhood friends, after all, and they promised not to harm anyone. But in the end, she couldn't avoid a confrontation. Regretting her decision, she threw herself into the fray, ending the conflict at the expense of her life.
141.Awk★ Lore:
Regretting all she'd done, she shared tears with the knight who hunted her down. Gasping, she murmured kindly to him. 
"I brought all this down on myself, you mustn't regret ending me. Be proud of all you've done as a knight to defend your village. And I am truly glad to die in your arms...You, who have cared more for me than any other." 
With her sacrifice, childhood friends long scattered were able to come together to revisit their younger days.

142.Name: Hot Egg
142.3★ Lore: These creatures possess an unknown heat source within them, and merging one with a fire hero soul can improve its abilities. They're a sought-after prize for any adventurer seeking mighty hero souls, but actually getting your hands on one is extremely difficult. Besides their inherent rarity, they're far more aggressive than their appearance would suggest, and will self-destruct as a defense mechanism, taking its surroundings with it... Or so the rumors say, anyway.

143.Name: Hot Chicken
143.4★ Lore: The heat within a Hot Egg provided plenty of nutrition for it to grow into a Hot Chicken, and because the heat source has grown with it, it can provide even more growth when absorbed by a fire hero soul. Hot Chickens create hot gusts of wind with a slight flapping of their wings, making them even harder to catch. Some rumors even say they can breathe fire! Emphasis on the rumor part, of course. They're super cozy to hold

144.Name: King Hot Chicken
144.5★ Lore: The heat source of a fully grown Hot Chicken is hot and compact enough to be compared to a furnace core. Their massive bodies always seem like they're about to blow, and you might get singed just trying to get in range: not an easy bird to catch. Hero souls that fuse with one can produce enough heat to warm an entire country, and a single King Hot Chicken is said to be worth as much as a 10,000 man army division.

145.Name: Aqua Egg
145.3★ Lore: A squishy lifeform filled with transparent, water-like fluid. Merging one with a water hero soul can improve its abilities via contact with the super pure fluids produced within. They're a must for adventurers seeking flexible hero souls, but good luck finding some. Due to their amphibious nature makes them hard to find, and if they sense danger, they'll quickly make themselves in a rubber ball-like shape in order to bounce far, far away.

146.Name: Aqua Chicken
146.4★ Lore: What's surprising about the Aqua Egg is that, despite being so squishy, it nonetheless takes the shape of a bird following incubation, and even gains the ability to fly. As it grows, the amount of fluid produced within its body increases, which should result in an even greater power boost for any water hero soul it merges with. They're even harder to catch now that they can fly, however. And adventurers love their unique squishiness, too!

147.Name: King Aqua Chicken
147.5★ Lore:
When an Aqua Chicken fills with pure fluid, it puffs up and expands to a size inconceivable for a mollusk: getting hit by one would probably shatter
every bone in your body. That it doesn't split apart despite its size makes it a natural wonder. A water hero soul that absorbs one of these gains incredible power, as if its entire body was suffused with holy water. Some even think it hails from some kind of long lost paradise...

148.Name: Leaf Egg
148.3★ Lore: Though it looks like a lone egg, this is actually an elusive plant lifeform that takes the form of a seed covering. Filled with the robust nutrients of the earth, any forest hero soul that absorbs one will gain a considerable power boost. A must-have for any adventurer seeking healing hero souls, but actually finding them is quite difficult. They possess an instinctual desire NOT to be caught, and flee from sight as soon as someone draws near, you see.

149.Name: Leaf Chicken
149.4★ Lore: Though various biologists have spent years theorizing on the subject, none can conclusively say what came first: the chicken or the seed. They've absorbed a tremendous amount of energy from the soil in order to grow, but that energy hasn't been lost. Far from it! In fact, a forest hero soul that merges with one will get a significant boost to its healing powers. Plus, being able to catch one as it flies about of its own volition would make a fine tale for the guild!

150.Name: King Leaf Chicken
150.5★ Lore: A King Leaf Chicken has become one with nature, and continues receiving earth's bounty to grow without limit. To catch one requires the dedication to catch not just a mere creature, but the entire forest itself. A forest hero soul that merges with one attains natural energies as boundless and expansive as the land itself. Stories tell of a tribe that once saw the King Leaf Chicken as a god, and worshipped it accordingly. Hardly surprising, considering the powers it holds...

151.Name: Light Egg
151.3★ Lore: An electric lifeform said to have come to earth alongside lightning itself. Though alive, it possess a power generator inside that amplifies the energy of any light hero soul it merges with. Adventurers in pursuit of radiant hero souls need them, but actually acquiring Light Eggs is tricky - and dangerous. Even if you can find their lightning-prone hiding spots, approaching carelessly will get you shocked instantly, or cooked to a crisp if you accidentally hurt the Egg's feelings.

152.Name: Light Chicken
152.4★ Lore: When the power generated inside a Light Egg exceeds a certain amount, it sheds its shell to take the form of a chicken. Light Chickens can zip through the sky to absorb electricity, storing up shocking amounts of energy. If a light hero soul absorbs one, it can gain an explosive amount of energy. You'll need to prepare yourself physically and emotionally to deal with lightning strikes from the sky if you want to get your hands on one. While wearing rubber gloves, of course.

153.Name: King Light Chicken
153.5★ Lore: The amount of electricity necessary to birth a King Light Chicken is said to be enough to power an entire country. They're practically like little electric power plants, and any adventurer trying to capture one does so with their life on the line. A light hero soul that merges with one will gain energy that feels a little like a series of explosions are going off inside you. In a good way. Historians theorize these creatures hold the key to explaining ancient Machine power sources.

155.4★ Lore:
He was once a wizard of La Riiz at the beginning of the Ancient War. He earned high office through quiet dedication and ability, mastering sorcery with ease.
 However, after an incident with the nation's ancient customs, he left the path of sorcery for a life of seclusion. The Lord of the Ancient Forest, revered as a sacred place, is usually controlled through a holy ritual performed every few years. Once every few years, it goes out of control. Hearing its rumors, he felt something head to the forest.
155.5★ Lore: He was famed among the wizards of La Riiz as a master of defense at the beginning of the Ancient War. Yet this he could not defend his only daughter from becoming a sacrifice to the Lord of the Ancient Forest. When he hears rumors of the Lord dunning amok, a girl riding his back, he realizes he might have a chance to meet the daughter he thought dead. Yet she refuses him. His despondency was only momentary, though as a sudden Demon appeared to attack the Lord and his rider. He stood before the Demon, his true power now unleashed.
155.Awk★ Lore: After he drove off the danger that came to the forest and its Lord, and his daughter with them, he called out to her once more, but she only shook her head. Understanding that one's past cannot be changed, the man turned to leave. However, a forest Spirit close to the Lord appears to stop him. "If you have the courage to become the forest's guardian, we will allow you to stay." The man swore to stay on, protecting the forest along with the mechanical doll that aided him in the earlier fight.

156.4★ Lore: A Spirit who watched over the ancient forest that spreads across La Riiz, and representative of its master. Ever by the master's side, she would employ her considerable powers to defend the forest against any threat. She was also in charge of watching over the girl chosen to become the next master and watched over her like a mother. When a Demoness suddenly appeared with the intent of making the master of the forest hers, Feld fought against her, day in, day out.
156.5★ Lore: A Spirit who fought to protect the master of the ancient forest. Feld fought back, but now had to face an automaton - and its country-obliterating firepower. She stood her ground, drawing out untapped and unthinkably great potential in the name of protecting the forest's master. Feld never so much as faltered... until the master, mad with rage, showed itself before her.
156.Awk★ Lore: The ancient forest's master and its guardian spirit faced a terrible dilemma at the hands of a Demonic invasion. Their rescue, and the automaton's halt, came at the hands of a mage claiming to be the forest master's father. When he pleaded that he wanted to live with his daughter again, the spirit calmly asked if he was ready to give up everything and live as the forest's guardian. Questioned about concerns for the forest's future itself rather than for its master, the man shed tears for some time before finally nodding.

At the end, he was given as a present to his master's daughter and now she was his new master.
157.4★ Lore: A mecha doll that was owned by a Demon during the first period of the Ancient War. Especially created for battles, he could wipe out a whole troop by itself. In order to perform efficient massacre, he had no ego and faithfully followed its master's orders. However, his master had vigorous powers and he was hardly used. At the end, he was given as a present to his master's daughter and now she was his new master.
157.5★ Lore: The humanoid weapon that a Demon's daughter had during the first period of the Ancient War. For fun, she started to invade an ancient forest and when she was resisted she used him. Although that he was finally being able to use his battle abilities, a Spirit stood in his way and did not give up to fight despite the difference in their powers. This created something like a "feeling" inside him. Although, he did not know how to handle this "feeling," once he was ordered to use his last ultimate weapon, he became "excited."
157.Awk★ Lore: A mechanized soldier in the service of a Demon noblewoman at the Ancient War's outset. An enemy sorcerer managed to seize control during a battle in the aged forest, forcing him to attack his rightful owner. As his logic unit told him those instructions were absolute, the projectile that narrowly missed her heart was attributed to a bug -- one that he found by desperately searching his memories.

158.4★ Lore: A girl who served as the symbol of La Riiz ancient forest. As far back as she could remember, Favelle always felt like she was riding on something enormous. She was: the Ancient Dragon, the Forest Master, a presence she treated as her father. After becoming able to communicate with the Dragon, she dedicated herself to the forest of her own volition. Unified with the Dragon, she fought against threats to the forest.
158.5★ Lore: A warrior who became the second master of the ancient forest. A Demoness seeking to make the Ancient Dragon her own used the terrifying power of her automaton to push the protector of the forest to the brink of defeat. Furious, the Forest Master took Favelle with him to drive her away. After a fierce battle, the automaton prepared to fire a devastating weapon to raze the entire forest, but its flames scorched the Demoness instead. When a panicked Favelle looked up to see who had saved her, she saw the broad back of someone she knew when she was a child right in front of her...
158.Awk★ Lore: Having avoided disaster, the man introduced himself to Favelle as her father. He told her that he wanted to live with her together again, as a family. Having decided to live forever in the forest alongside the Ancient Dragon, she refused. However, sensing his strong resolve, she allowed the man to live in the forest under the condition that he would become its protector. She agreed to this because of the faint memories she had of her father, and the determination of the man before her who was prepared to throw away everything if he could live with his daughter.

159.4★ Lore: A Beast bandit active prior to the Great War, Catilou led a bandit gang that robbed greedy businessmen and government officials exclusively. Most of the members of her gang were people who fell in love with Catilou's caring personality. One day, a lone intruder appeared on her turf. She didn't pay him much mind... until he knocked out some of her men. Taking hammer in hand, she prepared to take on the Human gunslinger who had dared to enter her turf.
159.5★ Lore: A Beast bandit active prior to the Great War. Catilou fought against the gunslinger who had knocked out her men. Midway through, however, she realized something: her men were unharmed, and had only had their weapons destroyed. Catilou dropped her weapon and admitted defeat, and the gunslinger apologized for mistaking her for the mark he had been chasing for years. They would travel together, and Catilou would eventually save the gunslinger during a fight against the fire dragon.

Seeing her horrendous powers, he recognized that she was the one he was looking for. Still, he was not able to raise his sword against her.
